title.zh: 让 Microduck 学会自主射门
title.en: Teach Microduck to score a goal

summary.zh: 先体验运动与训练，再从传统射门走向 GR00T、ASPIRE 与 Cosmos，理解机器人怎样学习动作、组织任务并适应新环境。
summary.en: Explore motion and training, then move from engineered football to GR00T, ASPIRE and Cosmos: learning actions, organizing tasks and adapting to new environments.

meta.zh: 9 章 · 中文 / English · 仿真实践与前沿方法
meta.en: 9 chapters · 中文 / English · Simulation and frontier methods

title.zh: 学习目标

blocks.zh: 以一台 Microduck、一个足球和一个球门为共同任务，先建立运动、仿真与训练基础，再比较手工流程、学习策略和任务智能体。前五章提供既有实验；第六章观看传统方案，后三章讲解前沿方法与接入条件。新方法尚未在本课程完成射门训练，不把架构示意当成成功实验。
blocks.en: Use one Microduck, one ball and one goal to connect motion, simulation and learning with engineered pipelines, learned policies and task agents. Chapters 1–5 retain existing labs, Chapter 6 reviews the baseline, and Chapters 7–9 explain frontier methods and readiness. New-method football training has not yet been completed here.

zh: Cosmos 与 Isaac 扩展环境
en: Expand environments with Cosmos and Isaac

title.zh: 学完后能够

zh: 解释机构、执行器、观测、动作与奖励的关系。
使用 Isaac Lab、Newton 与 Isaac Sim 体验固定策略及训练。
区分传统流程、VLA 动作预测与智能体任务组织。
借鉴 SO-101 数据流程，说明 Microduck 的示范与动作适配要求。
设计环境变化与独立评测，区分接口可行、模型指标与完整任务成功。
en: Explain mechanisms, actuators, observations, actions and rewards.
Explore fixed policies and learning with Isaac Lab, Newton and Isaac Sim.
Distinguish engineered pipelines, VLA actions and task agents.
Adapt the SO-101 data workflow to Microduck demonstration/action requirements.
Design variation and held-out evaluation; distinguish readiness from task success.

title.zh: 课程路线

zh: 认识 Microduck：先来踢一场球
拆解机械结构与控制周期
用 Isaac Lab 训练行走策略
探索社区的更多运动技能
从手工流程到智能机器人
让 GR00T 从示范中学习射门
用 ASPIRE 组织任务并积累技能
用 Cosmos 与 Isaac 覆盖不同家庭环境
en: From engineered pipelines to intelligent robots
Organize tasks and accumulate skills with ASPIRE
Cover different homes with Cosmos and Isaac

title.zh: 如何学习本课程

summary.zh: 选择观看、固定模型实践或训练练习。三种方式共用同一条知识主线。
summary.en: Choose observation, fixed-model labs, or training practice. All three follow the same learning sequence.

meta.zh: 阅读 · 预计学习时长 5 分钟

title.zh: 选择学习方式

zh: 阅读讲解，操作 3D 模型，查看媒体示例并回答检查题。
复制命令，在本机终端运行仿真，观察与记录结果。
已准备好的 GPU 环境
在实践基础上自己训练、导出和评估。
更多运行时间和磁盘空间
en: Read, inspect the 3D assembly, watch demonstrations, and answer checks.
Copy terminal commands, run simulation, and record observations.
Add your own training, export, and evaluation.

blocks.zh: 首次学习可先观看示例，再选择第三章、第四章的训练练习。第六章只观看传统任务流程；第七至九章讲前沿方法与接入条件，不要求安装新框架或训练大模型。没有 GPU 也可以完成全部阅读和网页交互。
blocks.en: Start with the demonstrations, then optionally practice training in Chapters 3 and 4. Chapter 6 is an overview; Chapters 7–9 explain frontier methods and integration requirements without new framework installation or large-model training. All reading and browser interactions work without a GPU.

title.zh: 预备知识

zh: 能够在 Linux 中打开终端、切换目录和复制多行命令。
能读懂简单的 Python 函数、数组和参数。无需先掌握 PPO。
知道坐标、角度和速度的含义；课程会解释机器人坐标系。
en: Open a Linux terminal, change directories, and copy multiline commands.
Read basic Python functions, arrays, and parameters. Prior PPO knowledge is not required.
Understand positions, angles, and velocities; robot coordinate frames are introduced in the course.

title.zh: 关于训练结果

blocks.zh: 自行训练得到的检查点只是练习产物。后续章节仍默认使用 models/ 中的课程模型，不会自动选取“最近训练的模型”。如需改用自行训练的策略，必须明确指定检查点，并重新进行评估。
blocks.en: Your checkpoint is a practice artifact. Later chapters explicitly use the course models in models/; they never select the latest training run automatically. Using your own policy requires an explicit checkpoint and a new evaluation.

title.zh: 每次实验怎么做

zh: 先阅读“预期结果”，明确需要观察的现象。
在课程仓库根目录执行命令。每个输出目录只用于一次运行。
保存运行命令、随机种子和结果，失败记录也要保留。
回答本章检查题，再进入下一章。
en: Read the expected result before running a command.
Run commands from the repository root. Use a new output directory for every run.
Keep the command, seed, and result—including failures.
Answer the chapter check before moving on.

blocks.zh: 正文标注的阅读与练习时长仅供安排学习进度，并不保证训练能在相同时间内完成。首次启动还可能需要下载资源、编译内核并创建渲染缓存。
blocks.en: Reading and exercise durations are planning estimates, not training-time guarantees. The first launch may download assets, compile kernels, and populate rendering caches.

title.zh: 准备环境与获取代码

summary.zh: 把课程页面、实验代码和固定模型放到同一个工作目录，然后检查运行环境。
summary.en: Keep the course, lab code, and fixed models in one workspace, then check the runtime.

meta.zh: 操作实验 · Ubuntu 24.04 / DGX Spark

title.zh: 运行条件

blocks.zh: 这里以 Ubuntu 24.04、DGX Spark（aarch64）、Python 3.12、Isaac Sim 6 以及锁定版本的 Isaac Lab / Newton 作为参考运行环境，仿真采用 Newton 的原生执行器路径。其他 GPU 或软件版本或许也能运行，但这些测试结果不能直接套用。
blocks.en: The reference environment is Ubuntu 24.04 on DGX Spark (aarch64), Python 3.12, Isaac Sim 6, and pinned Isaac Lab / Newton revisions. Simulation uses Newton’s native actuator path. Other GPUs or versions may run, but the course results do not automatically apply to them.

blocks.zh: 运行实验需要 NVIDIA 驱动、支持 GPU 的图形桌面、Git、Docker，以及能够访问 NVIDIA 软件源的网络；仅浏览课程网页则无需安装这些组件。安装 Isaac Sim 前，请先阅读其软件许可。
blocks.en: You need an NVIDIA driver, a GPU-enabled graphical desktop, Git, Docker, and network access to NVIDIA package sources. None of these are required for reading the website. Review the Isaac Sim license before installing the simulator.

title.zh: 下载课程与模型

blocks.zh: 在您希望存放课程的目录打开终端，运行下面的命令下载仓库并进入课程目录。
blocks.en: Open a terminal in the directory where you want to keep the course, then run the commands below to clone and enter the repository.

blocks.code:
mkdir -p "$HOME/microduck"
cd "$HOME/microduck"
git clone https://github.com/NV-DLI/Microduck-Workshop.git
cd Microduck-Workshop
python3 scripts/workshop.py verify-models
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: 模型会随仓库一同下载，无需另行登录 Hugging Face。校验命令会逐一核对文件的 SHA-256；只有全部一致后才能继续。提供的固定权重应与自行生成的输出分开保存。
blocks.en: The models are included in the repository, so no Hugging Face login is required. The verification command checks every model’s SHA-256. Continue only when all files match. Course weights and student outputs are stored separately.

blocks.code:
Microduck-Workshop/
├── web/          # HTML course
├── lab/          # simulation and learning code
├── models/       # fixed course models
├── scripts/      # lab entry points
└── outputs/      # your runs (created when needed)
blocks.label: Workspace

title.zh: 准备仿真环境

blocks.zh: 先确认系统工具可用。下面的命令将安装 Git、Python 虚拟环境支持和视频编码工具。Docker 需要预先按照 Ubuntu 安装说明 完成配置；运行 docker info 应能看到服务信息，且不能出现权限错误。
blocks.en: First prepare system tools. The commands below install Git, Python virtual-environment support, and video encoding. Set up Docker using its Ubuntu instructions; docker info should show server information without a permission error.

blocks.label: Terminal · Bash
blocks.code:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y git python3-venv ffmpeg
docker info
export UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600

python3 scripts/workshop.py setup
python3 scripts/workshop.py doctor
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: setup 会显示并执行锁定版本的安装步骤；如果已有版本匹配的 Isaac Lab，可以使用 --isaaclab /你的/IsaacLab目录 进行绑定。doctor 用于检查 Python、模型、GPU、桌面显示变量和导航依赖；所有失败项都应先处理完毕。
blocks.en: setup prepares the pinned runtime. If you already have a matching Isaac Lab checkout, bind it using --isaaclab /path/to/IsaacLab. doctor checks Python, models, GPU, the desktop display setting, and navigation dependencies. Resolve failed checks before continuing.

title.zh: 在桌面终端启动

blocks.zh: 需要图形界面的命令应在 GPU 机器的桌面终端中执行。课程网页只提供教材和命令，Isaac 窗口不会嵌入浏览器。首次打开场景时，请等待着色器和资源全部加载完成。
blocks.en: Run GUI commands in a terminal on the GPU machine’s desktop. The website provides lessons and commands; Isaac opens in its own window. On the first launch, allow shaders and assets to finish loading.

title.zh: 确认可以开始

blocks.zh: 在课程仓库根目录的终端中运行下面的命令，完成本节操作。若命令包含输出目录，请使用尚不存在的新目录，以保留此前的结果。
blocks.en: Run the command below in a terminal at the repository root. If it specifies an output directory, use a new one to retain earlier results.

blocks.zh: 预期结果：终端显示模型输入与输出的名称、形状，以及模型的 SHA-256 标识。如果系统未识别到 GPU，请先查阅故障排查；不要通过更换物理引擎或随意下载其他模型来绕过检查。
blocks.en: Expected result: input and output names, tensor shapes, and model identity. If the GPU is unavailable, use the troubleshooting page before proceeding. Keep the pinned physics backend and model combination.

title.zh: 认识 Microduck：先来踢一场球

summary.zh: 先用键盘指挥 Microduck 走路、转向和踢球，再看看 Isaac Sim 如何把场景、机器人和预训练策略连接起来。
summary.en: Meet Microduck: play football first. Explore the concepts, run the lab, and inspect its results.

meta.zh: 第 1 章 · 预计学习时长 20 分钟

title.zh: 一只可以学习新技能的小机器人
title.en: A small robot that learns new skills

blocks.zh: Microduck 是 Pollen Robotics 与 Hugging Face 推出的开源双足机器人。它有 14 个主动关节，可以通过训练获得行走、踢腿等技能。我们用 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 搭建可反复试验的场景，用 Isaac Lab 组织训练与评测，逐步让机器人自己找到足球并完成射门。先不训练：加载官方已经训练好的行走与右脚踢球 ONNX 策略，体验一次手动射门。
blocks.en: Microduck is an open biped from Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face with 14 actuated joints. Start with the official walking and right-foot kick ONNX policies in Isaac Sim, then learn how Isaac Lab trains and evaluates new skills.

title.zh: 打开球场，用键盘试一试
title.en: Open the pitch and try the keyboard

alt.zh: Isaac Sim 中的 Microduck 足球场景
alt.en: Microduck football scene in Isaac Sim

blocks.zh: 先用行走策略接近足球，再停稳并切换到右脚踢球动作。
blocks.en: Walk toward the ball, stop, then switch to the right-foot kick.

blocks.zh: 先完成环境准备，在课程仓库根目录打开终端。下面的命令会打开 Isaac Sim，场景中的机器人、足球和球门与第 6 章自主射门任务采用相同的尺寸与物理配置。将输入法切换到英文，鼠标点击仿真窗口后，用下面的按键操作。若按键没有反应，先检查是否仍处于中文输入状态。
blocks.en: Complete setup and run the command below from the repository root. Click the Isaac Sim window to focus it. The robot, ball and goal use the same dimensions and physical settings as the autonomous task. Use an English keyboard input mode so an IME does not consume movement keys.

zh: 给出零速度指令，回到站立
执行一次右脚踢球，然后切回站立
重置本次场景 / 退出

blocks.zh: 先走到球旁边，再停下来：球应位于右脚前方，身体朝向球门。按空格出脚。若踢空，先调整站位；若失去平衡，按 R 重来。这里由您判断球在哪里、应该朝哪走，策略只负责把指令变成关节动作。如果某次尝试没能进球，可以想一想：是站位偏了、朝向不对，还是出脚时机不合适？这些判断正是后面要交给自主射门系统的任务。
blocks.en: Walk toward the ball, stop with the ball in front of the right foot, and face the goal before pressing Space. Reposition after a miss; press R after a fall. You choose the target and direction; the policies coordinate the joints.

blocks.zh: 默认站立并不是另一个始终抢占控制的“站起”技能：行走策略持续运行，收到零移动指令时保持站立；摔倒后的站起、坐下和轮滑是不同技能。键盘实验直接在接触面上运行策略；第 6 章自主任务另外等待身体与观测稳定后才开始检测。
blocks.en: Default standing is the walking policy responding to zero movement commands. Getting up after a fall, sitting and rolling are separate skills. The keyboard lab starts its policy on the contact surface. Chapter 6 additionally gates autonomous detection on settled body motion and observations.

title.zh: 再用轮滑，把球碰进球门
title.en: Try a gliding shot on passive wheels

blocks.zh: 这一次从初始化到结束都使用轮滑模型：四个轮子是被动轮，仍由原来的 14 个舵机调整腿部姿态完成推进、转向和制动。无需切换走路，也不调用踢腿策略。先观察松开按键后仍会滑行，再练习提前减速；目标是把球碰进门，同时让小鸭子停在门前。
blocks.en: This run uses the roller model from initialization to the end. Its four wheels are passive; the same 14 servos propel, steer and brake through leg posture. It never switches to walking or invokes a leg kick. First observe coasting after key release, then practise slowing early so the ball enters the goal while the robot stops before it.

blocks.zh: 关闭上一场景后，在同一终端运行下面的命令。--locomotion rollers 选择轮滑的物理模型与固定策略，输出另存到一个新目录。
blocks.en: Close the previous scene, then run the command below in the same terminal. --locomotion rollers selects the roller physics model and fixed actor, writing to a new output directory.

zh: 制动；短按并观察，持续按住可能开始倒滑
调用一次有限时的滑行推射辅助；不会踢腿
重置 / 退出；A、D 不用于侧移
en: Brake briefly and observe; holding it can reverse motion
Coast; this does not guarantee a stop
Run a bounded gliding-shot helper; no leg kick
Reset / exit; A and D do not strafe

blocks.zh: 先用 W、Q、E 把球对到前轮前方，再用短促的 S 控制接近速度；您也可以在完成对位后试空格辅助。轮滑的推进量不是以米每秒为单位的速度目标，不能把 W 的内部数值直接当作实际速度。比较两种方式：步行射门先停稳再出脚；轮滑射门通过运动中的接触传递动量，随后制动。
blocks.en: Use W, Q and E to bring the ball in front of a wheel, then brief S presses to control approach speed; after alignment, you can also try the Space helper. The roller push input is not a velocity target in metres per second. Compare the modes: a walking shot settles before kicking; a gliding shot transfers momentum through moving contact and then brakes.

blocks.zh: 轮滑从已经展开的静止腿姿初始化，不先播放步行或踢腿动作。四个轮胎保留官方外观、质量和惯量；为了稳定计算滚动接触，碰撞采用直径 30 毫米、宽 7.6 毫米的圆柱近似，简化了胎肩圆角。键盘、射门和坡地的轮滑实验共用这一配置，实际轮胎的摩擦与变形尚未标定。
blocks.en: Roller mode initializes in a stationary roller posture. Official tyre visuals, mass and inertia are retained; rolling contacts use cylinders 30 mm in diameter and 7.6 mm wide, simplifying the rounded shoulders. Keyboard, football and slope roller experiments share this configuration. Real tyre friction and deformation remain uncalibrated.

title.zh: Isaac Sim 如何构成这场实验
title.en: How Isaac Sim builds the experiment

blocks.label: 从场景到运动
nodes: 机器人、球场、足球与球门
质量、碰撞、摩擦与执行器
键盘速度 → ONNX → 关节目标
blocks.zh: 画面、物理与策略各司其职。更换技能不需要重新制作场景；改变球的位置也不需要重新训练行走策略。
blocks.en: Rendering, physics and policy have separate roles. A different skill reuses the scene; a different ball position reuses the walking actor.

blocks.zh: 机器人 USD 不只是一张好看的网格：关节定义连接关系，碰撞形状决定接触位置，质量与惯量影响加速和转身，舵机模型影响目标角度如何变成实际运动。官网黑白足球的半径为 5 cm、质量为 30 g；球门内宽为 38.8 cm。Isaac Sim 提供场景与渲染，这里通过 Isaac Lab 的任务配置接入 Newton 物理后端。
blocks.en: The robot USD includes joints, collision geometry and inertial properties. The ball has a 5 cm radius and 30 g mass; the goal opening is 38.8 cm wide. Isaac Sim provides the scene and rendering; Isaac Lab configures the Newton physics backend.

blocks.code:
cfg.scene.ball = RigidObjectCfg(
    prim_path="{ENV_REGEX_NS}/Ball",
    spawn=sim_utils.SphereCfg(
        radius=0.05,
        mass_props=sim_utils.MassPropertiesCfg(mass=0.03),
        collision_props=sim_utils.CollisionPropertiesCfg(),
        rigid_props=UsdPhysicsRigidBodyCfg(rigid_body_enabled=True),
    ),
    init_state=RigidObjectCfg.InitialStateCfg(pos=(0.0, 0.0, 0.05)),
)
# Apply the shared official-ball asset, goal and floor materials.
scene_profile = configure_football(cfg, style="A")
blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

title.zh: 先固定场景与硬件约定
title.en: Fix the scene and hardware contract

blocks.zh: 本课程的室内射门场景使用 1 × 1.6 米垫子、外尺寸为宽 40 × 深 20 × 高 25 厘米的固定式钢网球门，以及官网直径 10 厘米、质量 30 克的黑白足球。垫子提供短距离接近和射门空间；它并不代表机器人已能在狭小场地中任意绕行。门框直径暂取 6 毫米，因此两根立柱的中心距为 39.4 厘米，净开口为宽 38.8、高 24.4 厘米。定位使用中心距，进球判定使用净开口，不能互换。
blocks.en: The indoor scene uses a 1 × 1.6 m mat, a secured steel-mesh goal measuring 40 cm wide × 20 cm deep × 25 cm high, and an official black-and-white ball with a 10 cm diameter and 30 g mass. This supports short approaches and shots, not arbitrary obstacle avoidance in a confined space. With an assumed 6 mm frame diameter, post centres are 39.4 cm apart and the clear opening is 38.8 × 24.4 cm. Localization uses centre spacing; scoring uses the clear opening.

blocks.zh: 地面提供两种足球场图案、浅色大理石和棕色木地板，均使用 1 × 1.6 米的展示区域、同一套机器人和灯光。球门按商品图做成侧面呈梯形、后网倾斜的钢网结构，固定其尺寸和材质。门框、网丝都有碰撞；地面暂按刚性平面处理，尚未模拟软垫压缩或起翘。不同贴图不意味着已经标定了各类实物地面的摩擦。
blocks.en: Choose two football graphics, pale marble or brown wood within the same 1 × 1.6 m area, robot and lighting. The fixed steel-mesh goal has trapezoidal sides and a sloping back, following the product photo. Frame and wires collide; the floor is a rigid plane without foam compression or raised edges. Different textures do not imply calibrated physical friction for each real surface.

alt.zh: 同一机器人和球门，四种地面样式
alt.en: Four mat patterns with the same robot and goal

blocks.zh: A：条纹足球场；B：简洁足球场；C：浅色大理石；D：棕色木地板。相同姿态用于观察地面外观变化，不代表四次任务结果。
blocks.en: A: striped football pitch; B: plain football pitch; C: pale marble; D: brown wood. The same pose isolates appearance; these are not four task outcomes.

blocks.zh: 机器人使用官方 Microduck CAD 与带齿隙的全身碰撞模型。课程锁定 XL330 的 BAM 电机拟合、200 Hz 物理和 50 Hz 策略周期；15 个实体舵机中，行走策略控制 14 个，嘴部不由这份策略独立驱动。全身碰撞让头、腿与电池等部位在摔倒后能受到地面支撑，避免只有脚有碰撞时身体穿过地面。
blocks.en: The robot uses official Microduck CAD with backlash and full-body collisions. The course pins the XL330 BAM actuator fit, 200 Hz physics and 50 Hz actor updates. The walking actor controls 14 of the 15 physical servos; it does not independently drive the mouth. Full-body collision geometry allows the head, legs and battery to rest on the ground after a fall.

blocks.zh: 这仍是有明确版本的仿真配置。相机型号对应 GC2093，但仿真采样为 960 × 540、15 Hz，70° 水平视场角尚未经过镜头标定；ToF 和身体 IMU 也有近似。它不能直接证明最新固件、所有硬件误差或 RK3566 上的完整部署已经复现。移到真机前，应核对实际硬件版本、电压、关节零位、镜头参数与端到端延迟。
blocks.en: This is a versioned simulation configuration. The camera corresponds to GC2093, but simulation samples at 960 × 540 and 15 Hz with an uncalibrated 70° horizontal field of view. ToF and body IMU models also contain approximations. This does not establish parity with every latest firmware or hardware error, nor validate full deployment on RK3566. Check the real hardware revision, voltage, joint offsets, lens parameters and end-to-end delay before transfer.

blocks.zh: 截至 2026 年 10 月 23 日，对照官方仓库，课程所用 CAD 网格、基础质量与关节参数、电机拟合与当日上游一致；本轮补入官方全身碰撞配置。机械展示仍保留 CAD 中的 Pi Zero 2 W 板外形，而当前 Beta 软件面向 RK3566。不能把这块展示网格当作最新电子硬件实物；整套真机对应关系仍需逐项核对。
blocks.en: Comparison with upstream on 23 October 2026 found no changes to the pinned CAD meshes, base mass/joint parameters or motor fit. This scene adds the official full-body contact configuration. The mechanical viewer retains the Pi Zero 2 W board mesh in the CAD, while current Beta software targets RK3566. The displayed board is not evidence of the latest electronics.

title.zh: 步行模式如何切换行走与踢球策略
title.en: How walking mode switches between gait and kick policies

zh: 速度非零时行走；速度为零时站立

blocks.zh: 步行模式中的两个官方策略都接收 61 维观测，输出 14 个关节动作。网络包含 512、256、128 个单元的三个隐藏层，使用 ELU 激活；输入归一化参数已包含在 ONNX 中，不要再做一次不匹配的归一化。键盘没有逐个操纵关节，而是改变速度指令。出脚时速度归零，短时调用踢球策略，再平滑切回站立。这里不加载踢球残差模型。
blocks.en: The two official policies used in walking mode accept 61 observations and output 14 joint actions. Hidden layers have 512, 256 and 128 units with ELU activation. Input normalization is embedded in ONNX. Keyboard input changes commands rather than individual joint angles. A shot briefly blends to the kick policy and back to the walking policy at zero movement command; this manual lab does not load the kick residual.

blocks.zh: 课程的步行与踢球组合保留经过原任务验证的固定官方权重；它们不等于官网网页模拟器当天的最新步行权重。轮滑实验单独使用本次核对的官网轮滑模型。硬件参数是否对应、策略文件是否相同、任务是否通过，是三个需要分别检查的问题。
blocks.en: The walking and kicking combination retains the fixed official weights used in the existing task validation; those files are not the latest browser walking weights. The roller lab separately uses the verified browser roller model. Hardware correspondence, policy identity and task success require separate checks.

blocks.zh: 两个官方策略都接收 61 维观测，输出 14 个关节动作。网络包含 512、256、128 个单元的三个隐藏层，使用 ELU 激活；输入归一化参数已包含在 ONNX 中，不要再做一次不匹配的归一化。键盘没有逐个操纵关节，而是改变速度指令。出脚时速度归零，短时调用踢球策略，再平滑切回站立。这里不加载踢球残差模型。
blocks.en: Both actors map 61 observations to 14 joint actions through hidden layers of 512, 256 and 128 units with ELU activations. Their input normalization is embedded in ONNX. Keyboard commands set velocity, not individual joint angles. A bounded kick blends back to standing; this lab does not load the course residual actor.

blocks.zh: 每列圆点只代表这一层的部分单元；数字才是实际维数。两个官方策略的结构相同、权重不同，因此能产生不同的动作技能。图中是推理用的策略网络，训练时使用的价值网络不在其中。
blocks.en: Circles show a subset of units; numbers give actual dimensions. The official walking and kick actors share this structure but have different weights. The training critic is not shown.

blocks.code:
# Read the state once per policy step, then select the active skill.
obs = env.observation_manager.compute(update_history=True)["policy"]
action = walk(obs)

if kick_start is not None:
    phase = (step - kick_start) * 0.02
    weight = 1.0 if phase < 0.14 else max(0.0, 1.0 - (phase - 0.14) / 0.12)
    if weight:
        action = torch.lerp(action, kick(obs), weight)

# The action manager maps network outputs to joint targets.
env.action_manager.process_action(action)
blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 手动实验把踢球保持时间设为 0.14 秒，再用 0.12 秒切回站立；这是本实验的技能切换设置，不是对官方权重的重新训练。策略文件大小小于 1 MB，不代表完整仿真只需要这么多显存。
blocks.en: The lab holds the kick for 0.14 s and blends back over 0.12 s. This is a handoff setting, not retraining of the official weights. Small policy files do not imply a small simulator memory footprint.

title.zh: 刚才是谁在决定下一步

question.zh: 刚才您已经完成了哪些机器人还不会自主完成的判断？
question.en: Which decisions did you make for the robot?

answer.zh: 您识别了足球和球门、估计了距离、选择了接近路线和出脚位置，并决定何时踢球。第六章展示手工流程怎样完成这些判断，第七至九章讨论学习策略与任务智能体。
answer.en: You identified the ball and goal, estimated distance, selected a route and stance, and decided when to kick. Chapter 6 shows an engineered pipeline; Chapters 7–9 explore learned policies and task agents.

blocks.zh: 下一章先看看这些动作背后的机械结构，以及策略和物理引擎按什么节奏协同工作。
blocks.en: Next, inspect the mechanism and the timing between policy and physics.

references.zh: Pollen Robotics：课程采用的官方策略版本

title.zh: 拆解机械结构与控制周期

summary.zh: 先把外壳、关节、执行器和传感器分开理解，再看它们如何组成一台可控制的机器人。
summary.en: Separate shells, joints, actuators, and sensors, then see how they form a controllable robot.

meta.zh: 第 2 章 · 预计学习时长 20 分钟

title.zh: 从整体到组件

blocks.zh: 在 Isaac Sim 中，机器人模型不仅包含外观，还定义关节、碰撞几何和质量属性。先认识 Microduck 的机械结构，后续才能把关节名称、动作向量与仿真中的运动对应起来。Isaac Lab 会在此基础上组织观测、动作和训练任务。
Microduck 是一台小型双足机器人：双腿承担支撑与移动，颈部机构负责调整视线，机身则容纳计算、电源和连接部件。视觉网格用于呈现外观，关节与碰撞模型用于规定可发生的运动和接触，二者在仿真中承担不同职责。
blocks.en: Microduck is a small biped. Its legs support and move the body, the neck directs its view, and the trunk houses computing, power, and connections. Visual meshes describe appearance. Joints and collision geometry describe permitted motion and contact. These play different roles in simulation.

blocks.zh: 将展开滑块移到中间，先找出左右腿和头颈部的舵机，再点击名称查看它们驱动的关节。继续展开，观察相机、主控板和电池的位置。最后返回总览，沿一条腿追踪关节之间的连接关系。
blocks.en: Move the separation slider to inspect the leg and head servos. Click their labels to identify the driven joints, then inspect the camera, controller board and battery. Reset to trace the leg joints.

title.zh: 硬件版本与仿真关节

blocks.zh: Microduck 配有 15 个舵机：两条腿各 5 个，头颈部 4 个，喙部 1 个。这里的仿真策略控制其中 14 个关节，喙部保持固定。图中保留了 CAD 的 Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W 板外形，它不代表当前 Beta 的 RK3566 电子配置，相机、ToF 测距和 IMU 在第六章用于观察任务，在第七章作为可学习策略的数据来源。
blocks.en: There are 15 servos: five per leg, four for the head and neck, and one for the beak. The policy drives 14 joints; the beak remains fixed. The CAD retains a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W board mesh; this is not the current Beta RK3566 electronics configuration. Chapters 6–7 connect camera, ToF and IMU data to task observation and learned policies.

title.zh: 先分清零件、关节和自由度
title.en: Parts, joints, and degrees of freedom

blocks.zh: 一支笔以笔尖为支点时可以朝多个方向转动，而铰链通常只能绕一条固定轴旋转，机器人关节也受到类似约束。自由度表示描述允许运动所需的独立变量数量，零件数量则表示装配体包含多少实体，两者并不相等。因此，网页中展示 70 个组件，并不意味着策略需要输出 70 个动作。
blocks.en: A pen held at its tip can rotate in several directions, while a hinge normally rotates around one fixed axis. Robot joints impose similar constraints. A degree of freedom is an independent variable needed to describe permitted motion; a component count describes physical pieces. The 70 components in this viewer do not imply 70 policy actions.

zh: 髋偏航、髋侧倾、髋俯仰、膝、踝，共 5 个
颈俯仰、头俯仰、头偏航、头侧倾，共 4 个
改变相机朝向与头部姿态
实物有舵机；本课程策略不控制
仅用于 3D 模型 展示，不计入 14 维策略动作
en: Hip yaw, roll, pitch; knee; ankle: 5 joints
Support the body and place the foot
Neck pitch; head pitch, yaw, roll: 4 joints
Physical servo; not controlled by this policy
Shown in 3D model, excluded from the 14-action interface

blocks.zh: 点击髋部舵机，观察输出轴及其附近的轴承。舵机驱动关节转动，轴承支撑旋转部件，支架连接相邻关节。对照模型，区分哪些零件随输出轴转动、哪些零件固定在上一级连杆上。
blocks.en: Select a hip servo and inspect its output shaft and nearby bearing. The servo controls an active angle, the bearing supports rotation, and brackets connect adjacent joints. Material, shape, and assembly clearance affect motion. The viewer preserves 3D model detail but does not simulate screw preload, plastic elasticity, or cable forces; it is an anatomy aid rather than manufacturing documentation.

title.zh: 软件如何让部件运动

blocks.zh: 策略不会直接把机器人移动到指定位置，而是输出一组动作，再由动作接口转换成关节目标。执行器根据目标状态与实际状态之间的差异产生力矩；机器人最终如何运动，还会受到接触、重力、惯量和摩擦的共同影响。
blocks.en: A policy does not teleport the robot to a desired position. It outputs actions that become joint targets. Actuators produce torque based on the difference between target and measured state. The resulting motion depends on contact, gravity, inertia, and friction.

blocks.zh: 这里的控制循环频率为 50 Hz，物理步进频率为 200 Hz，因此每个策略动作会持续四个物理步。齿隙模型还会引入被动关节来描述传动间隙，但这些关节并不是额外的策略输出。
blocks.en: The policy runs at 50 Hz and physics at 200 Hz: each action spans four physics steps. Backlash introduces passive joints representing transmission play. Passive joints are not additional policy outputs.

title.zh: 用坐标系描述运动

zh: 场地、球门和机器人整体位置
前进、侧移、转向指令以及球相对身体的位置
图像射线与检测目标方向
一个关节的旋转轴与角度
en: Pitch, goal, and overall robot position
Forward, lateral, and turn commands; ball relative to the robot
Image rays and detected target directions

question.zh: 头部关节保持不动时，相机画面一定稳定吗？
question.en: If the head joints stay fixed, is the camera image necessarily stable?

answer.zh: 不一定。机身可能发生俯仰和横滚，颈部也会随之运动。判断画面是否稳定，应观察相机相对于世界坐标系的姿态，不能只看头部关节角度。
answer.en: No. Body pitch and roll move the neck and camera. Image stability depends on camera orientation relative to the world, not only on joint angles.

title.zh: 练习：沿一条受力路径找部件

blocks.zh: 先在装配状态下沿脚踝、小腿、膝部、大腿和髋部向上追踪。脚掌着地后，支撑力会沿这条路径传到机身。随后展开模型，点击关节附近的舵机，辨认相邻连杆的连接方式。
blocks.en: Start with the assembled model. Trace a path from the left foot through the ankle, shin, knee, thigh, and hip. Ground support reaches the body through this chain. Explode the assembly and select the servos and brackets around a joint. Identify the fixed housing and the part driven by its output. Explosion offsets are display positions, not physically reachable joint poses.

blocks.zh: 舵机内部不仅有电机，还包括减速齿轮、位置反馈和控制电路。收到目标角度后，舵机需要一定时间进行跟踪，并受到可用扭矩、速度、摩擦和齿隙的限制。因此，“策略输出一个角度”不等于“关节立即到达该角度”。本章说明这一差别，第三章则介绍策略如何适应它。
blocks.en: A servo combines a motor, reduction gears, position feedback, and control electronics. Reaching a target takes time and is limited by torque, speed, friction, and backlash. A policy issuing an angle does not mean the joint instantly reaches it. Chapter 2 observes this difference; Chapter 3 explains how a policy learns around it.

question.zh: 在拆解图中把脚部拉得更远，会改变仿真的腿长吗？
question.en: Does moving the foot farther out in the exploded view change the simulated leg length?

answer.zh: 不会。网页中的拆解图只用于认识组件，仿真里的部件长度和关节连接仍由机器人描述文件定义。
answer.en: No. The web view explains components. Robot description files define simulated dimensions and joint connections.

title.zh: 策略收到什么，又输出什么
title.en: What the policy receives and produces

blocks.zh: 第一章使用已经训练好的策略进行推理：它把当前观测映射为 14 个关节动作，运行过程中不会更新神经网络参数。需要特别区分的是，更改速度指令只是在测试同一个模型的响应，并非重新训练；更新策略参数需要训练或更换模型权重。
blocks.en: Chapter 1 runs inference with a trained policy. It maps the current observation to 14 joint actions without updating neural-network parameters. Changing the velocity command tests the same model under a different request; it is not training. Choosing a different model file changes the policy.

zh: 角速度与身体坐标下的重力方向
身体正在怎样转动、倾斜
当前姿态与默认姿态的差异
上一次的控制输出，为策略提供时序信息
速度、头部与身体姿态指令
这一步希望机器人做什么
en: Pose relative to the nominal posture
Previous control output and temporal context

blocks.zh: 61 维观测按固定顺序拼接，归一化后经过三个隐藏层，得到 14 维动作。圆点数量为示意，层宽以数字为准。动作管理器再将动作转换为关节目标；相机图像不在这个行走策略的输入中。
blocks.en: Circles show a subset of units; numbers give actual dimensions. The official walking and kick actors share this structure but have different weights. The training critic is not shown.

blocks.zh: 这些数值合计构成 61 维输入。即使输入形状仍为 61，只要打乱关节顺序，语义就会被破坏，例如策略可能把膝关节状态误当成髋关节状态。实验入口会保持关节顺序、默认姿态和控制节拍一致。应先通过指令、时间预算和输出目录开展实验，理解接口后再修改底层观测。
blocks.en: These values total 61. Reordering joints breaks their meaning even if the input still has 61 entries: the policy might read a knee as a hip. Course entry points preserve ordering, nominal posture, and control timing. Begin by changing commands, duration, and output directories; modify observation construction only after understanding the interface.

blocks.zh: 现在已经知道策略如何读取状态、输出动作，以及舵机和物理仿真怎样执行这些动作。下一章从加载现成模型转向训练模型：用 Isaac Lab 让策略通过反复尝试学会行走。

title.zh: 用 Isaac Lab 训练行走策略

summary.zh: 前面直接加载了官方行走模型。这一章用 Isaac Lab 从头训练自己的策略，观察回报和行为如何变化，再与官方模型比较。
summary.en: Experience PPO training and understand observations, actions, rewards, and checkpoints while keeping downstream labs on fixed models.

meta.zh: 第 3 章 · 预计学习时长 30 分钟

title.zh: 一次强化学习循环

blocks.zh: Isaac Lab 把一项机器人学习任务拆成可组合的场景、观测、动作、命令、奖励、事件和终止项。策略接收机身姿态、角速度、关节状态、速度指令和上一动作，输出关节动作；Newton 在 GPU 上并行推进多个环境，奖励管理器计算反馈，PPO 收集一批交互后更新参数，再继续采样。这样可以在同一份任务定义中批量生成训练数据，也能逐项检查奖励和终止条件。
blocks.en: The policy receives a vector containing body attitude, angular velocity, joint state, a velocity command, and the previous action. It outputs joint actions, physics advances, and rewards measure progress toward the objective. PPO collects a batch of interactions, updates the policy, and samples again.

blocks.zh: “环境数量”决定 Isaac Lab 在 GPU 上向量化运行多少个机器人副本，“迭代次数”决定重复多少轮采样与更新。每个副本都保留独立状态；事件与终止管理器可以只重置已结束的环境，使其他副本继续采样。增加环境数量通常能提高每轮采样量，但也会占用更多显存。训练奖励上升只说明策略在优化目标上的表现有所改善，实际行为仍需在独立场景中检验。
blocks.en: The environment count is the number of simultaneous robot copies. Iterations repeat collection and optimization. More environments increase parallel sampling and memory demand. A rising training reward means the optimized objective is improving; independent behavior checks are still necessary.

title.zh: PPO 为什么不是“每一步奖励高就保留”
title.en: Why PPO looks beyond immediate reward

blocks.zh: 机器人迈步时，短暂抬起一只脚会暂时降低稳定性，却又是向前移动的必要动作。因此，强化学习关注一段时间内的累计回报，而不是只评价当前一步。折扣因子会让更远期奖励的权重逐渐降低，从而平衡短期反馈与长期效果。
blocks.en: Lifting a foot can briefly reduce stability while being necessary for forward progress. Reinforcement learning therefore considers return over time rather than just the current reward. A discount factor reduces the weight of more distant rewards, balancing immediate feedback with longer-term consequences.

blocks.zh: 在 PPO 中，actor 根据观测选择动作，critic 则估计从当前状态出发能够获得的预期回报。当某个动作的结果优于 critic 的预期时，优势估计为正，更新会倾向于提高该动作出现的概率；结果不及预期时则相反。PPO 通过限制单次更新偏离旧策略的幅度来减轻策略突变带来的不稳定，但它并不保证每次更新都能提升真实任务的成功率。
blocks.en: In PPO, the actor chooses actions and the critic estimates future return. An outcome better than the critic expected receives a positive advantage estimate, encouraging a higher probability for the corresponding action; a worse outcome does the opposite. PPO limits how far an update moves from the old policy to reduce abrupt changes. It does not guarantee that every update improves real task success.

blocks.zh: 训练期间可以向 critic 提供更多仿真信息，帮助它评价轨迹；部署后的 actor 却只能依赖运行时实际可获得的观测。例如，仿真引擎能够读取精确的机身速度，并不代表真实机器人拥有毫无误差的速度传感器。仅供训练或评分使用的真值不得接入部署控制器。
blocks.en: A critic may receive additional simulation information to evaluate trajectories, but the deployed actor must depend only on observations available at runtime. A simulator knowing exact body velocity does not imply that hardware has a perfect velocity sensor. Keep training or scoring ground truth out of the deployed controller.

blocks.zh: 设计奖励时，应先列出期望行为，再分析策略可能利用的捷径。例如，“奖励球移动”可能诱使机器人用身体撞球，“奖励保持不动”则可能使其拒绝行走。可行的检查方法是同时记录目标指标与约束，包括速度误差、回合长度、摔倒情况、关节范围和触球方式。第三章只用于练习训练循环，完整任务的成功标准将在第六章检验。
blocks.en: When designing rewards, list desired behaviors and then consider shortcuts. Rewarding ball motion may encourage body collisions; rewarding stillness may discourage walking. Track both goals and constraints: velocity error, episode length, falls, joint limits, and contact type. This chapter practices the training loop; Chapter 6 tests the complete task definition.

title.zh: 运行一次短训练练习

blocks.zh: 下面的命令不加载官方行走权重，也不恢复旧检查点，而是从头开始训练。先用小预算确认完整流程可以运行，再决定是否增加训练轮数。
这项练习旨在走通训练工作流，20 次迭代只是练习预算，不表示策略已经学会行走。预期结果：终端显示训练进度，新目录中生成训练记录、检查点和导出的策略。练习重点是观察损失、回报与回合长度如何变化，无需等待长时间训练。
blocks.en: This is a workflow exercise, not a promise that 20 iterations will learn to walk. Expected result: terminal progress, a new run directory, checkpoints, and an exported policy. Observe loss, return, and episode length without committing to a long training run.

blocks.zh: 在浏览器中打开终端显示的本地 TensorBoard 地址，观察回报与回合长度是否同步改善。如果回报有所增长但回合仍然很短，应检查奖励设计是否允许机器人短暂得分后立即摔倒。
blocks.en: Open the local TensorBoard address printed in the terminal. Compare reward with episode length. If reward grows while episodes remain short, consider whether the objective rewards a brief action followed by a fall.

blocks.zh: 当前练习使用全身碰撞模型，头和腿在跌倒时也能与地面接触。新输出独立保存；课程中的历史训练曲线仍对应其原配置，不与新练习混为同一次训练。训练不渲染画面，策略回放使用统一的 RTX 光照与材质。
blocks.en: Current practice uses full-body contacts, including the head and legs during falls. New outputs are separate experiments; historical learning curves retain their original configuration. Training does not render frames; policy playback uses the shared RTX lighting and materials.

title.zh: 从流程检查到完整训练
title.en: From a smoke run to a longer training run

blocks.zh: 20 轮练习用于确认采样、PPO 更新、保存与导出都能运行，不足以证明机器人学会行走。若要继续体验技能形成，可另开一个输出目录，增加并行环境数与训练轮数。下面给出 1024 个环境、2500 轮的训练预算；是否已经收敛，仍要看曲线与独立评测，不能只看轮数。
blocks.en: The 20-iteration exercise checks the pipeline, not convergence. A longer run below uses 1024 environments for 2500 iterations in a new output directory. Judge convergence with curves and independent evaluation, not iteration count alone.

blocks.zh: 训练时打开 TensorBoard，检查回合奖励、回合长度、跌倒与速度误差是否共同改善。若只做短练习，下一节使用 outputs/student-walk-01/exported/policy.onnx；若完成了上面的训练，则显式换成 outputs/walking-training-01/exported/policy.onnx。两种练习都不会覆盖官方模型。
blocks.en: Use TensorBoard to compare reward, episode length, falls and velocity error. Use the short-run export in the next section, or explicitly select outputs/walking-training-01/exported/policy.onnx after this longer run. Neither changes the official model.

title.zh: 显式测试自己的策略

blocks.zh: 在课程仓库根目录的终端中运行下面的命令，完成本节操作。若命令包含输出目录，请使用尚不存在的新目录，以保留此前的结果。
blocks.en: Run the command below in a terminal at the repository root. If it specifies an output directory, use a new one to retain earlier results.

blocks.zh: 此处必须明确选择自行训练的模型，并将其支撑、漂移和摔倒情况与第一章的官方模型进行比较。完成练习后，后续章节仍会使用 models/walk.onnx；本次导出不会改变课程的默认策略。
blocks.en: Here you deliberately select your own model. Compare support, drift, and falls with the official model from Chapter 1. Later lessons still use models/walk.onnx; this export does not change their default.

title.zh: 进一步练习

blocks.zh: 如需增加训练预算，请新建输出目录，并将环境数和迭代数调整为例如 1024 与 500；开始前先确认内存和可用时间。保存检查点不代表策略已经合格，还应使用未参与训练的种子进行评估，并保留失败结果。
blocks.en: To increase the budget, choose a new output directory and try, for example, 1,024 environments and 500 iterations. Check available memory and time first. A saved checkpoint is not a qualification result. Evaluate unseen seeds and retain failures.

blocks.zh: 比较时，两次运行的速度、时长与种子必须相同。先比较有没有跌倒、实际前进距离与速度，再测试零速度时能否站稳。不要把一次“走出去”的视频当成完整技能通过；曲线变好却没有达到目标，也是一条需要解释的实验结果。
blocks.en: Match command, duration and seed. Compare falls, distance and actual velocity, then test standing at zero command. One moving demonstration is not a complete skill benchmark.

title.zh: 为什么要做域随机化

blocks.zh: 真实舵机的摩擦、延迟和齿隙并不会在每次运行中完全一致。Isaac Lab 的事件管理器可以在环境重置或指定时刻为各并行副本改变这些参数，让策略在同一训练批次中接触更丰富的情形。随机化范围过窄可能造成过拟合，范围过宽又可能使任务难以学会。分析时以保存于 env.yaml 的实际配置作为解释依据；域随机化有助于提高鲁棒性，但不能取代真机验证。
blocks.en: Real actuators do not have identical friction, delay, and backlash on every run. Varying parameters in training exposes the policy to more conditions. A narrow range can overfit; an excessively broad range can make learning difficult. Randomization can improve robustness but does not replace hardware testing.

question.zh: 为什么不能把训练过程中回报最高的一次当作独立测试结果？
question.en: Why is the highest-reward training episode not an independent test?

answer.zh: 因为这次结果已经参与学习或模型选择，而且奖励高并不必然等于任务成功。独立测试应预先确定场景和成功标准，并在未参与选型的条件下统计全部结果。
answer.en: It contributed to learning or selection, and reward may differ from task success. Independent testing uses predetermined scenarios and success criteria and counts every outcome.

title.zh: 检查点、训练曲线与独立测试

blocks.zh: 训练从随机参数开始，不会加载课程提供的行走权重。每轮 PPO 都先从多个环境收集轨迹，再利用这些轨迹更新策略。奖励通常由速度跟踪、机身姿态、动作平滑性和接触相关项共同组成。两个总奖励相同的策略，可能分别依靠“速度更准确”和“少动更稳定”获得分数，因此必须同时检查实际行为与各项奖励。
blocks.en: Practice starts from random parameters rather than the course walking weights. Each PPO iteration gathers trajectories from several environments and then updates the policy. Rewards combine velocity tracking, body attitude, action smoothness, and contact-related terms. Two policies with similar total rewards may obtain them through accurate motion or simply moving less; inspect both behavior and individual reward terms.

blocks.zh: initial.pt 保存训练起点，model_*.pt 保存训练检查点，env.yaml 和 agent.yaml 保存环境与优化配置，exported/policy.onnx 则是供推理使用的导出文件。检查点可能包含优化器等训练状态，而 ONNX 通常只保留推理所需的计算图，因此两种文件格式不能随意互换。
blocks.en: initial.pt records initialization; model_*.pt files are checkpoints; env.yaml and agent.yaml preserve environment and optimizer settings; exported/policy.onnx is the inference export. A checkpoint can contain optimizer state, while ONNX normally preserves the inference graph. They are not interchangeable file formats.

blocks.zh: 建议记录三项信息：训练预算、未参与训练的测试种子和实际行为。20 轮练习只用于走通采样、更新、保存与导出流程；即使练习模型表现不佳，也不要因此替换后续章节的固定模型。增加预算时应保留原实验、使用新的输出目录，并注明改动的是环境数、迭代数还是奖励。
blocks.en: Record the training budget, held-out test seeds, and observed behavior. The 20-iteration exercise teaches sampling, updates, saving, and export. A weak practice policy is no reason to replace downstream course defaults. For a larger budget, keep the earlier run, use a new output directory, and state whether you changed environment count, iteration count, or rewards.

question.zh: 只保存 ONNX 文件，能否保证从中精确续训？
question.en: Does saving only ONNX guarantee an exact training continuation?

answer.zh: 不能。精确续训还需要优化器状态、归一化状态、随机状态以及相同的配置等信息，因此必须保留完整检查点和训练配置。
answer.en: No. Exact continuation also needs optimizer, normalization and random states, together with matching configuration. Preserve full checkpoints and training settings.

title.zh: 平地上学会的动作，能走上坡吗
title.en: Will a flat-ground skill handle a slope?

blocks.zh: 现在已经走过采样、PPO 更新、导出和测试的流程。自己的策略是否学会行走，仍以实际评测为准。接下来提出一个新问题：即使一个策略在平地上走得很好，遇到坡道时，原来的抬脚高度、落脚位置和重心调整还够用吗？先写下预测，再到下一章用官方行走策略建立统一的坡地基线。
blocks.en: You can now collect rollouts, update PPO, export ONNX and test a policy. Will its foot clearance and balance adjustments work on a slope? Predict the outcome, then test the same policy in Chapter 4.

title.zh: 让行走技能适应坡地

summary.zh: 用 Isaac Sim 构建可控的坡道，在 Isaac Lab 中测试现有策略，再用多种地形训练并比较结果。
summary.en: Adapt walking to slopes. Explore the concepts, run the lab, and inspect its results.

meta.zh: 第 4 章 · 预计学习时长 30 分钟

title.zh: 先提出可检验的问题

blocks.zh: 本章不预设“旧模型一定会摔倒”。任务是从平地出发，走上或走下一段坡道，抵达另一端并保持平衡。先固定模型、速度、时长、摩擦和起点扰动，只改变坡度。这样才能判断性能变化来自地形，而不是换了几项设置。
blocks.en: Do not assume the old actor will fail. Hold the policy, command, duration, friction and initial-state distribution fixed while varying slope. Test traversal and balance, not just a single attractive frame.

blocks.label: 地形泛化实验
nodes: 同一策略：平地 / 上坡 / 下坡
对比到达率、跌倒率与速度误差
blocks.zh: 先测后训；保留平地能力，再检查坡地能力是否提高。
blocks.en: Evaluate before adapting. Retain flat-ground ability while testing improvements on slopes.

title.zh: 搭建平地—坡道—平台场景

blocks.zh: 评测场景由三段连续表面组成：出发后 0.35 m 为平地，接着是水平长度 1 m 的坡道，最后是落脚平台。正角度表示上坡，负角度表示下坡。用一个连续碰撞网格连接它们，避免装饰性台阶意外改变实验。视觉材质与灯光用于辨认坡面；质量、摩擦和碰撞几何才决定接触运动。
blocks.en: The surface has a 0.35 m flat approach, a 1 m horizontal ramp, and a landing. Positive angles ascend; negative angles descend. A continuous collision mesh avoids unintended steps. Visual materials do not determine contact dynamics.

alt.zh: Isaac Sim 中的平地、上坡和目标线
alt.en: Isaac Sim flat approach, ramp and target line

blocks.zh: 深色区域标出坡面，金色虚线帮助观察行走方向，绿色横线是到达位置的参考标记。标线与颜色不改变物理接触。
blocks.en: The darker surface marks the ramp; gold guides show direction and green marks the target. These visual markings do not change contact physics.

blocks.label: 平地、坡道与平台的侧视图
blocks.zh: 拖动滑块比较上坡与下坡。横向和高度使用相同比例；改变坡度会同时改变平台高度。
blocks.en: Adjust the slope to compare ascent and descent. Horizontal and vertical scales match; the landing height changes with the angle.

blocks.code:
slope = math.tan(math.radians(cfg.slope_deg))
xs = [-48.0, 2.35, 3.35, 52.0]
zs = [0.0, 0.0, slope, slope]
vertices = [(x, y, z) for x, z in zip(xs, zs) for y in [-48.0, 52.0]]
origin = np.array([2.0, 2.0, 0.0])
blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 网格坐标的起点为 (2, 2, 0)；减去这个原点后，机器人相对起点为 x = 0，坡道从 x = 0.35 m 延伸到 1.35 m。前后的支撑面总计扩展到 100 × 100 m，避免失败后从小块地形边缘掉落。Isaac Lab 的 TerrainGenerator 和 TerrainImporter 让同一几何用于可视化、物理测试与并行训练。
blocks.en: The mesh origin is (2, 2, 0). Subtracting it places the robot at relative x = 0 and the ramp between x = 0.35 m and 1.35 m. Continuous approach and landing support extends across 100 × 100 m so failures do not fall off a small terrain tile. Isaac Lab’s TerrainGenerator and TerrainImporter share this geometry across visualization, physics tests and parallel training.

title.zh: 先测官方行走策略
title.en: Test the official walking policy first

blocks.zh: 先让官方行走策略在 5° 上坡运行 20 秒。在课程仓库根目录打开终端，运行下面的命令；输出目录应使用尚不存在的新名称。
blocks.en: Run the official walking policy on a 5° uphill ramp for 20 seconds. Run the command below from the repository root with a new output directory.

blocks.zh: 不加 --headless 会打开 Isaac Sim。批量评测时使用 --num-envs 5 --headless；将坡度依次改为 0、5、−5、10、−10、15、−15，并给每次运行使用新的输出目录。前 2 秒站立，随后给出 0.25 m/s 前进指令；实际速度由策略和物理系统共同决定，并不保证等于指令。
blocks.en: Without --headless this opens Isaac Sim. Use --num-envs 5 --headless for batched evaluation, and test 0, ±5, ±10 and ±15 degrees in separate output directories. The first 2 s are standing; then the command is 0.25 m/s. Actual speed may differ.

blocks.zh: 达到目标须在 20 秒内走到 x ≥ 1.45 m，抵达时横向偏移小于 0.3 m，并且整段实验不跌倒。跌倒后不自动重置；机器人即使随后滑过终点，也不计为成功。报告分别保存到达情况、跌倒情况和速度均方根误差。
blocks.en: Success requires reaching x ≥ 1.45 m within 20 s with lateral error below 0.3 m and staying upright throughout. A fall remains a failure even if the body later slides across the finish. Reports separate reaching, falls and velocity RMSE.

blocks.zh: 这组基线每个坡度使用 5 个起点轻微扰动的环境。平地 5/5 通过；上坡没有跌倒，但停滞在坡道中；下坡 5/5 跌倒。它说明当前模型需要适应这些地形，但样本数较小，不应据此推断任意坡地的可靠性。
blocks.en: Each angle uses five lightly perturbed starts. Flat trials pass; uphill trials stall without falling; downhill trials fall. This small baseline identifies an adaptation need, not general reliability.

title.zh: 为什么平地经验不能直接覆盖坡地
title.en: Why flat-ground experience may not transfer

blocks.zh: 坡面改变了脚与地面的相对高度、重力沿坡方向的分量和可用摩擦。上坡时，抬脚和推进不足可能让机器人停在坡上；下坡时，重心向前移动与落脚高度变化可能让机器人来不及恢复平衡。仅看“是否摔倒”会漏掉上坡停滞，因此到达率与速度误差也很重要。
blocks.en: A slope changes foot clearance, gravity along the surface and usable friction. Insufficient clearance or propulsion can stall ascent; downhill landing and balance changes can cause falls. Survival alone misses stalled traversal.

blocks.zh: Newton 会在每个物理步计算重力、接触和执行器响应；Isaac Lab 则让同一策略在多种坡度上反复试验。我们不必手写一套上坡步态，但需要让训练场景和奖励覆盖这些变化。

title.zh: 拓展：坡度怎样改变重力与摩擦
title.en: 拓展：坡度怎样改变重力与摩擦

blocks.zh: 把重力沿坡面和垂直坡面两个方向分解，就能理解为什么上坡需要更多推进、下坡更需要控制速度。这里把机器人暂时看作坡面上的一个物体，用准静态近似说明趋势。

blocks.label: 坡面上的重力分量与简化摩擦约束

blocks.zh: m 是质量，g 是重力加速度，α 在这里取坡面与水平面的夹角大小；前面测试中的正负号只用来区分上坡和下坡。沿坡向下的分量 mg sin α 会阻碍上坡、促进下坡；垂直坡面的分量 mg cos α 决定近似支持力 N。α = 0 时，沿坡分量为零；坡越陡，这个分量越大。
μ 是摩擦系数，F_tangent 是接触面所需的切向力。要保持不滑动，所需切向力的大小不能超过 μN。以 10° 坡道为例，沿坡重力约为重量的 17%，支持力约为重量的 98%；这些比例说明受力趋势，不能直接变成策略的最大坡度。
这个近似忽略了迈步加速、单脚支撑和足底碰撞。实际行走时支持力会变化，Newton 会逐步求解相应动力学。判断策略是否适用，仍要同时检查到达、跌倒和速度误差。

title.zh: 在多种地形中继续学习

blocks.zh: 保留官方 ONNX，复制其网络权重与归一化参数作为新策略的起点。训练使用 25% 平地、其余为不同坡度的上坡和下坡地形；环境并行收集不同状态下的经验。新价值网络与优化器单独初始化。训练前先检查新策略网络与原 ONNX 对同一观测的输出一致，避免接口错误被误认为“需要更多训练”。
blocks.en: Keep the official ONNX unchanged. Initialize a new actor from its weights and normalization, with a fresh critic and optimizer. Mix 25% flat terrain with ascending and descending terrain. Verify initial actor parity before learning.

blocks.zh: 这里的坡度参数是 tan(α)，不是角度值；范围 0.03–0.22 对应约 1.7°–12.4°。训练地形使用金字塔坡面与反向坡面，评测保留直线坡道，因此不是在训练场景原位重复演示。训练和评测随机种子也分开。
blocks.en: Training slopes are tan(α), not degrees: 0.03–0.22 is about 1.7°–12.4°. Training uses pyramidal and inverted slopes; evaluation uses straight ramps and separate seeds.

blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 本节固定坡地权重保留原训练结果。当前训练入口使用与演示一致的全身碰撞资产，因此新练习的接触配置与历史训练不同，输出属于新实验。训练本身不渲染画面；完成后用统一 RTX 场景检查导出的策略。
blocks.en: The fixed terrain weights retain their original training lineage. Current practice runs use the same full-contact robot as the demonstrations, so their contact configuration differs from the historical training and defines a new experiment. Training is physics-only; inspect exported policies in the shared RTX scene.

title.zh: 不仅要站稳，还要走向目标

blocks.zh: 在坡道上，站稳只是第一步。机器人还要朝目标方向走：即使一直迈步，只要出现持续的小幅转向，走过一段距离后也会偏离落脚平台。前进速度奖励主要约束机身坐标系下的速度，身体转偏后仍可能“向自己的前方走得很好”，因此需要单独检查转向速度。
先把期望行为写清楚：指令要求直行时，绕身体 z 轴的角速度应接近零；指令要求转弯时，实际角速度应接近指令。这里约束的是转向速度，不是身体始终朝向某个固定世界方向；它也不能直接修正已经积累的航向误差。坡面上身体 z 轴与世界竖直方向不完全重合，这仍是一个局部控制指标。

blocks.label: 第一步：定义有物理含义的误差

blocks.zh: ωz 是机身坐标系中绕 z 轴的角速度，训练时从仿真状态读取；ωz* 是转向指令，单位都是 rad/s。误差可以为正也可以为负，两边都需要惩罚，所以用平方；再除以容忍尺度 σ，把不同量级的误差变为无量纲数。这里取 σ = 0.15 rad/s，表示我们希望重点区分这一量级附近的转向误差。

blocks.label: 第二步：把误差转换为平滑、有界的奖励

blocks.zh: 误差为零时奖励为 1；误差增大时奖励平滑降向 0，而且左右转偏受到同样的影响。这个指数形式是便于优化的一种设计选择，不是由物理定律唯一推出的公式。σ 太小，大多数动作都只能得到接近零的奖励；σ 太大，又难以区分方向保持得好不好。

zh: 小幅偏差仍有较高奖励
误差达到容忍尺度，奖励明显降低
偏差较大，几乎得不到这一项奖励

blocks.label: Python · 核心代码节选

blocks.zh: 代码取出所有并行环境的机身角速度和转向指令，按环境逐项计算上式。weight = 4 把原始奖励乘以 4，再交给 Isaac Lab 的奖励管理器与其他项组合；管理器还按策略步长统一缩放。它表示相对重视程度，不是“成功率提高 4 倍”。姿态、动作平滑和前进速度项仍然保留，防止策略只顾停止转动而不走路。
为什么单独取 z 分量？行走本身伴随横滚和俯仰角速度。如果把三轴误差一起放进过窄的奖励范围，正常步态的晃动也可能压低得分。单独的 z 轴项让转向反馈更明确，同时继续用其他奖励约束身体稳定。

blocks.label: Terminal
blocks.code:
python3 scripts/workshop.py train-terrain \
  --model models/walk.onnx \
  --resume outputs/terrain-training-01/model_999.pt \
  --refine-heading --num-envs 256 --iterations 1500 --seed 43002 \
  --output outputs/terrain-heading-01

python3 scripts/workshop.py train-terrain \
  --model models/walk.onnx \
  --resume outputs/terrain-heading-01/model_2498.pt \
  --refine-heading --yaw-precision \
  --num-envs 256 --iterations 2000 --seed 43003 \
  --output outputs/terrain-direction-01

blocks.zh: 第一条命令继续训练并加强原有角速度跟踪，同时固定名义物理参数。第二条增加独立的 z 轴转向奖励，也调整了原角速度项和线速度项的权重。每一步都从已有检查点继续，原官方模型保留；改变训练轮数后，请以实际保存的检查点文件名为准。
怎样验证它是否有用？先在 TensorBoard 看这一项的平均奖励，再用相同坡度、相同速度指令和独立种子比较实际角速度误差、横向偏移、到达率与跌倒率。奖励提高而机器人不前进，或走得更直却频繁摔倒，都不能算改进。奖励是训练信号，任务条件才是最后的验收标准。
已有实验提供了什么证据？前一阶段的策略在 +5° 开发测试中走上坡道，却因横向偏离而未通过到达条件；后续策略在相同开发坡度上达到 5/5，固定模型后的独立评测也在 +5° 达到 5/5。不过，后续阶段还改变了其他奖励设置并增加了训练轮数，因此这组结果只能说明整套调整有效，不能单独证明转向奖励的因果贡献。

title.zh: 拓展：设计一个只检验转向奖励的消融实验
title.en: 拓展：设计一个只检验转向奖励的消融实验

blocks.zh: 从同一个检查点复制两份训练，保持地形、指令分布、其他奖励、优化器、训练步数和种子配对一致。实验组启用 z 轴转向奖励，对照组只把这一项权重设为零；用多个训练种子重复。这样比较的才是这一项奖励带来的差异。
训练后冻结两个候选策略，用未参与调参的相同评测种子逐对测试。预先约定比较转向速度误差、横向偏移、到达率和跌倒率，并报告所有结果。如果转向误差下降且到达率提高，同时没有增加跌倒，才有更充分的证据支持这个设计。这里提供的是可选实验设计，尚未完成这组独立消融。

title.zh: 用同一把尺子比较新旧策略
title.en: Compare both actors with the same benchmark

alt.zh: 上坡 10°时官方策略与坡地策略对比

blocks.zh: 上坡 10°：上方为官方策略，下方为坡地策略。同一速度指令下，前者在坡道前部停滞，后者继续走到目标区域。两次运行使用相同的起点设置，按仿真时间同步播放；这是单组演示，整体表现以下表为准。
blocks.en: Ascent10°: official actor above, terrain actor below. The original stalls while the adapted actor reaches the target. Matched starts and synchronized simulation time; this illustration does not replace the full benchmark.

alt.zh: 下坡 10°时官方策略与坡地策略对比

blocks.zh: 下坡 10°：上方为官方策略，下方为坡地策略。官方策略失去平衡后仍由连续地面支撑；坡地策略保持站立，但这次运行的横向偏移超出到达条件，判为未通过。两次运行使用相同起点设置，按仿真时间同步播放；宽镜头保留走过坡道后的运动。这组演示使用单独的种子，不计入下表；没有跌倒不等于完成任务。
blocks.en: Downhill at 10°: the official policy is above and the terrain policy below. The official robot loses balance but remains supported by the continuous ground. The terrain policy stays upright but fails the arrival condition because of lateral drift. Both use the same starting setup and play in synchronized simulation time; the wide view retains motion beyond the ramp. This separate recording seed is excluded from the table below. Staying upright is not the same as completing the task.

blocks.zh: 默认使用已训练好的 models/terrain-walk.onnx，大小约 0.79 MB；想评估自己的模型时，将路径显式改为 outputs/terrain-direction-01/exported/policy.onnx。这个坡地模型只用于本章，第一章与第六章仍使用原行走策略。
blocks.en: Use the fixed0.79 MB terrain actor by default. Explicitly select outputs/terrain-direction-01/exported/policy.onnx to test your own export. Chapters1 and7 retain the original walking actor.

blocks.zh: 对官方模型和新模型使用相同的评测种子与坡度表。至少同时报告平地、上坡和下坡的通过数、跌倒数、速度误差及训练耗时。没有跌倒但停在坡上，属于未完成任务；坡地改善却丢失平地能力，也不算合格替代。学生训练出的模型只有经过这样的验证，才适合显式替换默认策略。
blocks.en: Use matched evaluation seeds and angles for both actors. Report flat, uphill and downhill success, falls, tracking error and training time. Stalling is not success, and slope improvements do not justify losing flat-ground ability.

blocks.zh: 表中每个坡度各运行 5 个环境，使用未参与模型训练与选型的固定评测种子 49001，两种策略均使用官方全身碰撞模型。支撑面修正时复用了同一种子，不计作额外独立样本。通过要求与前面完全相同；表中的速度 RMSE 是五个环境的均值，每个环境仅统计首次跌倒前、开始前进后的采样，避免跌落后的运动混入行走误差。到达时横向偏移小于 0.3 m，不等于全程严格沿直线行走。样本较少，这些结果不能推广为任意坡地的成功率。完整条件与逐环境结果见评测数据。
blocks.en: Each angle uses five environments with fixed seed 49001, excluded from model training and selection, and official full-body contacts for both actors. Reusing this seed after correcting the support surface does not create additional independent samples. Success criteria are unchanged. The table averages each environment’s speed RMSE over moving-command samples before its first fall. The lateral gate applies at arrival, not continuously. This small sample does not establish general slope reliability. See the per-environment results.

blocks.zh: 坡地策略在平地、±5°和上坡 10°保持较好的通过表现；下坡 10°虽然五次都没有跌倒，但三次偏离到达区域，±15°则全部跌倒。这说明稳定性、行走方向和任务完成是不同指标。每个坡度仅五次，不能把结果差异全部归因于某个参数。先检查失败轨迹，再决定是否增加训练难度或调整奖励；行走接口相同，也不意味着这份坡地策略已经适配自主射门的接近与出脚切换。
blocks.en: The terrain actor passes all five trials on flat ground, ±5° and +10°. At −10° it stays upright in all five but misses the arrival region three times; it falls in every ±15° trial. Stability, direction and completion are distinct metrics. Five trials per angle cannot isolate a parameter effect. Inspect failures before changing training; the shared interface does not qualify this actor for football approach and kick handoff.

question.zh: 为什么评测坡道不应和训练地形完全相同？
question.en: Why evaluate on terrain geometry different from training?

answer.zh: 目的是检验学到的能力能否适应新的起点与几何，而不仅是在熟悉的布局里重复动作。两种模型应共享评测条件，且评测结果不能反过来当作独立测试仍未见过的数据。
answer.en: To test transfer to new geometry and initial states. Both actors share evaluation conditions; tuning on those results makes them development data.

title.zh: 同一条坡道，再试轮滑模式
title.en: Try the same ramp on passive wheels

blocks.zh: 四个轮子会改变支撑与阻力。上坡时必须通过腿部动作持续提供推进，下坡时松开指令仍可能加速；不能把平地轮滑直接当成坡地技能。这里沿用相同坡面、连续支撑地面、20 秒时限、到达位置与不跌倒标准，另列轮滑结果。推进命令与行走的速度命令语义不同，因此不比较两者的速度跟踪误差。
blocks.en: Wheels change support and resistance. Climbing requires propulsion through leg motion, while releasing input downhill may still permit acceleration. We retain the same ramp, continuous support surface, 20-second limit, arrival target and no-fall requirement, and report roller results separately. Roller push and walking velocity commands have different meanings, so their velocity-tracking errors are not compared.

alt.zh: 官方轮滑策略在 5 度上坡时发生明显侧偏
alt.en: Official roller actor drifts sideways on a 5-degree incline

blocks.zh: 这是 +5° 上坡回合的前 7 秒：小鸭子保持轮滑姿态，但逐渐横向偏离测试通道。完整 20 秒记录中未跌倒，却没有满足到达位置要求。这次录像使用另一个种子 55012，不计入下表；片段用于观察侧偏过程，不代表成功上坡。
blocks.en: The first 7 seconds of a +5° trial show the robot remaining on its wheels but drifting out of the test corridor. The complete 20-second record has no fall but fails the arrival criterion. This recording uses a separate seed, 55012, excluded from the table. The clip illustrates drift, not successful climbing.

blocks.zh: 下面的命令在 +5° 坡道上运行 5 个轮滑副本。先看终端结果中的 passed 与 fell；需要录像时改为一个环境并增加 --record，为每次运行换一个输出目录。
blocks.en: The command below runs five roller environments on a +5° ramp. Inspect passed and fell. For recording, select one environment and add --record; use a new output directory each time.

blocks.code:
python3 scripts/workshop.py terrain \
  --locomotion rollers \
  --model models/official-browser/rollers.onnx \
  --slope 5 --seconds 20 --num-envs 5 \
  --seed 55011 \
  --output outputs/rollers-slope-01
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: 进一步试 −5°、+10° 和 −10°。记录“是否到达”和“整段是否跌倒”两个不同结果：下坡滑过终点后摔倒仍不算通过。这里没有换用专门训练的坡地轮滑模型，失败也是这项迁移实验的有效结果。
blocks.en: Then try −5°, +10° and −10°. Record arrival and whole-episode survival separately: crossing the finish downhill and falling later is still a failure. This experiment does not substitute a slope-trained roller policy; failure is a valid transfer result.

blocks.zh: 这组固定官方轮滑策略在平地通过 5/5；+5° 上坡虽然全部保持直立，却明显横向偏离，未满足规定的到达位置。它尚不能直接替代坡地行走策略。种子 55011 在轮胎接触修正时复用，属于固定配置核查，不是新增的独立泛化样本；它与前表步行实验的种子也不同。完整记录见轮滑坡地结果。
blocks.en: The fixed official roller actor passed 5/5 on level ground. All +5° trials stayed upright but drifted far sideways and missed the required arrival region. It cannot directly replace the slope walking policy. Seed 55011 was reused while correcting tyre contacts: this is a fixed-configuration check, not an additional independent generalization set, and its seed differs from the walking table. See the roller slope results.

title.zh: 同一套平台，还能学会什么
title.en: What else can this platform teach?

blocks.zh: 您已经用 Isaac Sim 改变了任务环境，用 Isaac Lab 继续训练，并通过统一评测检验了技能的适用范围。下一章看看社区如何用不同任务、观测与奖励，让 Microduck 学会跳跃和平衡等动作。
blocks.en: You changed the world with Isaac Sim, adapted a policy in Isaac Lab and tested its scope. Next, explore community jumping and balancing tasks.

references.zh: Isaac Lab：任务、地形与并行训练
references.en: Isaac Lab: tasks, terrain and parallel learning

references.zh: 坡地策略：网络、训练配置与模型信息
references.en: Terrain actor: network, training and model information

title.zh: 探索社区的更多运动技能

summary.zh: 用同样的观察—动作—奖励思路，认识社区的跳跃、篮球平衡与技能切换。
summary.en: Explore jumping, ball balancing and skill handoffs using the same observation–action–reward framework.

meta.zh: 第 5 章 · 预计学习时长 20 分钟

title.zh: 同一机器人，可以学什么
title.en: What else can the same robot learn?

blocks.zh: 前两次训练关注行走与地形适应。社区还用强化学习训练了跳跃、篮球平衡等技能：硬件可以相同，但任务、奖励、初始状态与结束条件不同。下面的社区演示来自各项目自己的仿真环境；它们展示技能思路，不代表已在这里的 Newton 场景或真机上通过相同评测。
blocks.en: Community projects train jumping and ball balancing using different tasks, rewards and initial states. These demonstrations come from their original simulation environments and do not establish equivalent Newton or hardware performance.

alt.zh: 社区跳跃演示，按原作品的四倍慢动作播放。观察起跳、腾空、落地以及切回站立的衔接。
alt.en: Community jump demonstration in the original four-times slow motion. Observe takeoff, flight, landing and the standing handoff.

blocks.zh: 社区跳跃演示，按原作品的四倍慢动作播放。观察起跳、腾空、落地以及切回站立的衔接。
blocks.en: Community jump demonstration in the original four-times slow motion. Observe takeoff, flight, landing and the standing handoff.

alt.zh: 社区篮球平衡演示。观察脚下支撑面随球转动而变化，机器人怎样持续调整姿态。
alt.en: Community ball-balancing demonstration: watch the moving support surface and continuous posture corrections.

blocks.zh: 社区篮球平衡演示。观察脚下支撑面随球转动而变化，机器人怎样持续调整姿态。
blocks.en: Community ball-balancing demonstration: watch the moving support surface and continuous posture corrections.

zh: 本体状态与一次性起跳指令 → 关节动作
起跳高度、落地姿态、落地后是否站稳
机器人与球的状态 → 关节动作
持续平衡、球与身体位置、存活时长
本体状态与速度指令 → 关节动作
速度跟踪、稳定性、能耗与动作平滑性
en: Body state and a jump command → joint actions
Robot and ball state → joint actions
Body state and velocity command → joint actions
Speed tracking, stability, energy and smoothness

blocks.zh: 迁移这些技能时，可在 Isaac Sim 添加对应的道具和接触几何，再通过 Isaac Lab 配置观测、奖励与重置分布。即使观测维度相同，也不保证模型能直接互换：例如社区跳跃把速度指令的第一个分量用作起跳开关，必须遵循该技能的接口约定。
blocks.en: Isaac Sim supplies props and contact geometry; Isaac Lab organizes observations, rewards and reset distributions. Equal observation dimensions do not guarantee compatibility: the jump policy repurposes a command field as a launch trigger.

title.zh: 给技能定义边界

blocks.zh: 行走策略可以持续接收速度指令，而踢球是一个有明确起止点的短时技能。Isaac Lab 的任务结构便于复用相同的观测、动作与执行器接口，并用命令、事件和终止条件表达技能边界；Newton 的接触与机身状态则让“脚确实碰球”和“机器人恢复站稳”成为可检查条件。要把踢球接入自主任务，除了定义动作本身，还必须说明何时允许启动、结束后应进入什么状态，以及发生失败时如何停止。
blocks.en: Walking continuously accepts velocity commands. A kick is a short skill with a start and an end. Integrating it into an autonomous task requires entry conditions, a defined exit state, and a way to stop when conditions are unsafe.

zh: 球是否在可踢区域，身体朝向是否合适，观测是否仍在有效期内
由真实足部接触推动球，而不是直接修改球状态
及时结束出脚并回到支撑状态
机器人保持稳定，没有摔倒或关节越界
en: Body state and a jump command → joint actions
Robot and ball state → joint actions
Body state and velocity command → joint actions
Speed tracking, stability, energy and smoothness

title.zh: 为什么两个 ONNX 不能随意互换
title.en: Why ONNX files are not interchangeable

blocks.zh: ONNX 只是一种模型表示格式，并不是统一的机器人技能协议。行走模型读取 61 维输入，当前踢球残差模型读取 62 维输入；即使两者都输出 14 个数，也不能直接互换。输入顺序、附加状态、动作缩放、教师混合方式和结束条件都属于模型的运行约定。
blocks.en: ONNX is a model representation, not a universal robot-skill protocol. The walking model takes 61 inputs, while the kicking residual takes 62. Both output 14 numbers, yet they are not interchangeable. Input ordering, additional state, action scaling, teacher blending, and termination conditions are all part of the runtime contract.

blocks.zh: “文件能够成功加载”只能证明模型格式可读，不能证明机器人能够完成动作。单位、关节顺序和缩放仍需与控制器一致；模型与数据页列出了固定权重的用途。第六章会展示这些技能组成完整任务后的表现。
blocks.en: Loading a model only establishes that its format is readable. Units, joint order and scaling must match the controller. The models page lists the fixed weights and their roles. Chapter 6 shows the complete task assembled from these skills.

blocks.zh: 观看出脚过程时，可以分三个阶段观察：出脚前，检查球与支撑脚的位置是否合适；出脚过程中，观察摆动腿是否形成足够空间，并用物理接触记录确认接触来自脚部而非身体其他部位；出脚后，观察重心是否重新回到支撑区域、机身倾角是否收敛。请分别描述技能的进入条件与完成条件。相比只看“球有没有动”，这种观察方式更能反映机器人系统的实际要求。
blocks.en: Watch the kick in three phases: before it, inspect ball and support-foot positions; during it, identify whether contact comes from the foot or another body part; afterwards, inspect recovery of support. Pause the video in each phase and describe the entry and completion conditions. This is more informative than asking only whether the ball moved.

title.zh: 用输入、输出与结束条件描述技能
title.en: Describe a skill by its contract

blocks.zh: 描述一项技能时，可以拆分为四部分：进入条件、所用观测、输出动作和退出时机。以射门为例，球必须位于适合右脚出脚的位置，机身朝向球门，支撑保持稳定，而且目标观测尚未过期。技能执行期间会结合踢球教师策略与残差修正；结束后还必须恢复到稳定的站立或行走状态，不能把“已经碰到球”直接当作任务完成。
blocks.en: Describe a skill using entry conditions, observations, actions, and exit conditions. A kick requires a useful right-foot ball position, goal alignment, stable support, and fresh target information. Execution combines the kicking teacher with a residual correction. It must then return to a stable standing or walking state; touching the ball alone does not finish the task.

blocks.zh: 残差可以看作对已有动作施加的受约束修正。这样做缩小了需要从头学习的问题范围，同时也会继承教师策略的适用边界。如果在远离球的位置启动局部射门技能，它不会因此自动学会找球或接近目标。导航模块负责创造技能可以接手的条件，技能模块则负责完成局部动作。
blocks.en: A residual adds a constrained correction to an existing action. This reduces what must be learned from scratch but inherits the teacher’s operating range. Starting a local kick far from the ball does not make it search or approach. Navigation creates a valid handoff state; the skill performs its local action.

question.zh: 机器人已走到球旁，但球的位置记忆过期。应立刻运行踢球技能吗？
question.en: The robot is beside the ball, but its remembered position has expired. Should the kick start immediately?

answer.zh: 不应立即运行。需要先重新观察并确认进入条件；仅仅靠近目标，并不能保证技能输入仍然有效。
answer.en: No. Observe again and confirm the entry conditions. Proximity alone does not guarantee valid inputs.

title.zh: 会执行动作，还不等于会完成任务
title.en: Executing a skill is not completing a task

blocks.zh: 目前主要由我们告诉机器人“向前走”或“现在踢”。策略已利用关节和 IMU 反馈保持平衡，却还不能自己决定足球在哪里、该走哪条路。下一章先观看传统感知与规划怎样串起完整射门，再讨论怎样把更多判断交给可学习的模型。
blocks.en: We currently tell the robot when to move or kick. Joint and IMU feedback support balance, but the policy does not decide where the ball is or which route to take. Next we review a complete perception/planning pipeline, then consider how learned models can take on more decisions.

references.zh: 社区跳跃：模型、慢动作视频与衔接说明
references.en: Community jump: actor, slow-motion video and handoff

references.zh: 社区篮球平衡：演示、训练与评测
references.en: Community basketball: demonstration, training and evaluation

title.zh: 从手工流程到智能机器人
title.en: From engineered pipelines to intelligent robots

summary.zh: 看懂传统自主射门的流程与实际效果，再思考：哪些判断可以交给能学习、推理与复用经验的模型？
summary.en: See how the engineered football pipeline works, then identify what learned policies and reasoning agents could take over.

meta.zh: 第 6 章 · 预计学习时长 15 分钟

title.zh: 传统方法怎样完成射门

blocks.zh: 前面我们获得了行走、轮滑和踢球等运动技能。要把它们组成完整任务，还需要决定看哪里、往哪里移动、何时触球、失败后怎么办。本章只看流程和效果，不需要安装、运行代码或手算站位。
blocks.en: The earlier chapters provide walking, skating and kicking skills. A complete task must also decide where to look, where to move, when to contact the ball and how to recover. This chapter is a guided overview: no installation, code execution or position calculations are required.

blocks.label: 人设计判断流程，已有策略执行运动。
nodes: 找到球、球门与接近路线
调用行走、踢球或轮滑技能
blocks.zh: 人设计判断流程，已有策略执行运动。
blocks.en: People design the decision flow; existing policies execute motion.

english_diagram.label: People design the decision flow; existing policies execute motion.

blocks.zh: 传统方法用相机投影和坐标变换把图像中的目标联系到机器人身体，再根据“球后站位、朝向球门”这样的任务先验生成接近目标。相关公式解决的是位置和方向的换算，本章不展开推导。步行分支使用 ROS 2 Nav2/Navfn 规划与自有跟踪控制；轮滑分支使用视觉反馈。Isaac ROS 可以提供可集成的感知能力，但当前射门实验没有运行 Isaac ROS 包。
blocks.en: Camera projection and frame transforms relate image targets to the robot. A task prior—stand behind the ball and face the goal—defines the approach target. These calculations translate positions and directions; we omit their derivation here. Walking uses ROS 2 Nav2/Navfn planning with a custom tracker; skating uses visual feedback. Isaac ROS offers integration options for perception, but it is not running in this experiment.

title.zh: 观看步行射门

alt.zh: 真实步行开发示例，保留观察、反复对齐、踢球与恢复的完整过程。第三视角按原物理记录重渲染，右上角为同步的原相机画面；单次成功不代表可靠率。
alt.en: A complete walking development example, including observation, repeated alignment, kicking and recovery. The observer view is re-rendered from recorded physics with the original synchronized camera inset. One success is not a reliability estimate.

blocks.zh: 真实步行开发示例，保留观察、反复对齐、踢球与恢复的完整过程。第三视角按原物理记录重渲染，右上角为同步的原相机画面；单次成功不代表可靠率。
blocks.en: A complete walking development example, including observation, repeated alignment, kicking and recovery. The observer view is re-rendered from recorded physics with the original synchronized camera inset. One success is not a reliability estimate.

blocks.zh: 低头再调整的循环是真实控制行为。记录中有多次短转向，转向后要停稳并重新获得近处球的有效观测；朝向误差变化又会触发下一轮。改善连续观测、转向制动和进入/退出阈值的迟滞，有望减少往返切换，但需要配对物理测试确认。本章保留原速完整过程，不用剪辑把尚未解决的问题藏起来。
blocks.en: The look-down and alignment cycles are real controller behavior. Short turns are followed by settling and fresh near-ball observations; a changed heading error can trigger another cycle. Continuous observation, improved turn braking and separate entry/exit thresholds could reduce switching, but require paired physical tests. The complete real-time sequence remains visible.

title.zh: 观看轮滑碰球

alt.zh: 轮滑开发示例：6.79 秒真实触球、8.13 秒整球越线，随后在门前停稳。初始化到结束保持轮滑模式，没有切换踢腿。第三视角重渲染与原相机同步。
alt.en: Gliding development example: contact at 6.79 s, whole-ball crossing at 8.13 s, then settling before the goal. The robot stays on its wheels throughout; no leg-kick transition occurs. The re-rendered observer view is synchronized with the original camera.

blocks.zh: 轮滑开发示例：6.79 秒真实触球、8.13 秒整球越线，随后在门前停稳。初始化到结束保持轮滑模式，没有切换踢腿。第三视角重渲染与原相机同步。
blocks.en: Gliding development example: contact at 6.79 s, whole-ball crossing at 8.13 s, then settling before the goal. The robot stays on its wheels throughout; no leg-kick transition occurs. The re-rendered observer view is synchronized with the original camera.

blocks.zh: 两种动作的决策规则不同。轮滑要控制接近速度和制动，步行要满足踢球策略的进入姿态。换一个任务时，工程师还要重新设计这些衔接条件。
blocks.en: The decision rules differ: skating requires approach and braking control; walking must enter the kicking policy in a suitable pose. A different task requires new handoff rules.

title.zh: 效果：成功演示与独立测试分开看

zh: 均未跌倒，失败发生在观测或交接阶段
有进球后停车失败，也有门柱定位未完成
en: No falls; observation or handoff failed

blocks.zh: 每组四次、每种地面一个预定新种子，样式和种子同时改变，因此不能据此证明某种地面造成失败。检测器的测试 mAP50 已达到 0.978，完整任务仍不稳定：认出目标、估计几何、完成动作是不同的问题。旧场景成绩不混入这里。
blocks.en: Each group has four predeclared trials, one new seed per floor. Floor and seed change together, so these trials do not establish a causal floor effect. Detection mAP50 is 0.978, yet the full task remains inconsistent: recognition, geometric estimation and execution are different problems. Historical scene scores are kept separate.

title.zh: 让机器人学习动作，也学习组织任务
title.en: Learn actions and how to organize them

blocks.zh: 手工流程的优点是可解释、容易逐步检查；代价是人需要理解任务，安排步骤、阈值与失败恢复。面对“把球送到另一端”“绕过椅子再射门”等新要求，维护成本会继续增加。我们希望把更多经验放进可学习的策略和可复用的技能，而不是为每个任务重新编排全部细节。
blocks.en: Engineered pipelines are interpretable and easy to inspect step by step. They also require people to specify stages, thresholds and recovery. Requests such as moving the ball elsewhere or going around a chair create more integration work. Learned policies and reusable skills can carry more of that experience.

blocks.label: 接下来的三章分别回答“怎么动、怎么组织任务、怎么覆盖变化”。
nodes: 从图像、语言与示范学习动作
尝试、诊断、改写程序、积累技能
扩展数据，构建场景并验证泛化
blocks.zh: 接下来的三章分别回答“怎么动、怎么组织任务、怎么覆盖变化”。
blocks.en: The next three chapters address action, task organization and variation.

english_diagram.label: The next three chapters address action, task organization and variation.
nodes: Learn actions from images, language and demonstrations
Try, diagnose, revise programs and retain skills
Expand data, compose scenes and evaluate generalization

blocks.zh: 大模型可以减少逐任务手写决策的负担，但仍需要机器人动作接口、基础运动能力和结果检查。下面讲的是接入方法与已核查的接口；尚未把 GR00T 或 ASPIRE 的 Microduck 射门结果写成已完成实验。
blocks.en: Foundation models can reduce task-specific decision programming. They still need action interfaces, underlying movement skills and outcome checks. The following chapters explain the integration design and inspected interfaces; they do not claim a completed GR00T or ASPIRE Microduck football experiment.

title.zh: 让 GR00T 从示范中学习射门

summary.zh: 从 SO-101 sim2real 的数据流程出发，理解视觉—语言—动作模型如何适配 Microduck，以及微调前必须准备什么。
summary.en: Adapt the SO-101 sim-to-real data workflow to Microduck: what a vision-language-action model learns and what adaptation requires.

meta.zh: 第 7 章 · 预计学习时长 25 分钟

title.zh: 用目标与示范表达任务
title.en: Express the task through goals and demonstrations

blocks.zh: 给机器人一句“把球送进球门”，再提供成功完成任务的示范，是另一种表达任务的方法。视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA）根据相机图像、任务指令和机器人状态预测接下来的一段动作。许多原来分散在“看球、调整、前进”规则里的经验，可以由数据学习。
blocks.en: A language goal such as “send the ball into the goal,” paired with successful demonstrations, offers another way to specify the task. A vision-language-action model uses images, instructions and robot state to predict a short action sequence. Data can capture decisions previously distributed across looking, alignment and approach rules.

blocks.label: GR00T 反复观察并预测短动作段；环境反馈形成闭环。
nodes: 图像 + 指令 + 机器人状态
理解当前情境，预测动作段
执行短前缀，保持底层稳定
blocks.zh: GR00T 反复观察并预测短动作段；环境反馈形成闭环。
blocks.en: GR00T repeatedly observes and predicts short action segments in a feedback loop.

english_diagram.label: GR00T repeatedly observes and predicts short action segments in a feedback loop.
nodes: Interpret context and predict an action chunk
Execute a short prefix; maintain stability

blocks.zh: “预测动作”与“规划整项任务”相关，但并不相同。GR00T 的动作段不是一条已经避开所有障碍的全局路径；较长任务还需要目标管理、检查与恢复。下一章再讨论如何让智能体组织这些能力。
blocks.en: Action prediction and whole-task planning are related but distinct. An action chunk is not a globally collision-free path. Longer tasks also need goal management, checks and recovery, which the next chapter addresses.

title.zh: 使用当前公开的 GR00T N1.7
title.en: Use the current public GR00T N1.7

blocks.zh: 截至 2026 年 10 月 26 日，官方仓库当前公开版本为 GR00T N1.7，基础模型标识为 nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B。它使用 Cosmos-Reason2-2B / Qwen3-VL 视觉语言骨干与动作生成头；这不等于已把后文的 Cosmos 3 接进同一个模型。官方提供自定义机器人数据微调与策略服务接口。
blocks.en: As checked on 26 October 2026, the current public release is GR00T N1.7, with base checkpoint nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B. It uses a Cosmos-Reason2-2B / Qwen3-VL backbone and an action head; that does not mean Cosmos 3 is already part of this model. Official workflows support custom-robot fine-tuning and policy serving.

blocks.zh: Microduck 尚不是我们已经验证的预训练机器人。SO-101 的六维机械臂动作、GR00T 的通用张量容量和 Microduck 的十四个受控关节，不能按“维数差不多”直接互换。需要明确每个动作的物理含义、单位、频率、归一化和控制器接口。
blocks.en: Microduck is not a pretrained embodiment validated here. SO-101 arm actions, the model’s tensor capacity and Microduck’s fourteen controlled joints are not interchangeable. Every action needs a defined physical meaning, unit, rate, normalization and controller interface.

title.zh: 从 SO-101 课程迁移什么
title.en: What transfers from the SO-101 course

blocks.zh: 机械臂 sim2real 课程的关键链路可以复用：遥操作采集同步图像、状态与动作，整理成 LeRobot 数据，微调 GR00T，在仿真和实物上分别评测。课程还改变光照、机器人颜色和垫子等外观，帮助策略适应观察差异。这里迁移的是数据与评测方法，不是直接把试管抓取权重当成足球策略。
blocks.en: The SO-101 course supplies a reusable workflow: teleoperate, record synchronized images/state/actions, prepare LeRobot data, adapt GR00T, then evaluate simulation and hardware separately. Lighting, robot color and mat variations broaden visual coverage. The transferable part is this data and evaluation method; vial-manipulation weights are not a football policy.

zh: 保留机身运动、头部视线与动作时间
示范接近、碰球/踢球、制动与恢复
先验证新场景，再做实机镜头和动力学标定
覆盖不同家庭光照、背景和地面
en: Retain body motion, gaze and action timing
Demonstrate approach, contact, braking and recovery
Test new scenes before hardware calibration
Cover home lighting, backgrounds and floors

title.zh: 先定义模型能控制什么
title.en: Define what the model may control

blocks.zh: 较稳妥的第一条研究路线，是保留已有行走与轮滑策略，让学习模型输出有界的身体运动与视线请求，减少手写“观察—对齐—推进”的阶段切换。步行和轮滑的指令含义不同，应使用独立配置或显式模式条件；轮滑射门仍从开始到结束保持轮滑。踢球技能的触发可以由上层决定，不能把一个连续数值直接当成没有验证的离散技能切换。
blocks.en: A practical first research route retains the locomotion policies and learns bounded body-motion and gaze requests, reducing hand-written observation/alignment/advance transitions. Walking and skating have different command semantics: use separate configurations or an explicit mode condition. A gliding shot remains in roller mode throughout. A higher-level controller can request a kicking skill; a continuous number is not automatically a validated discrete skill switch.

blocks.zh: 另一条路线是学习关节动作，但它同时承担平衡与接触控制，数据与验证成本更高。N1.7 的官方新机器人示例允许配置非末端执行器动作，因此接口并非只能用于机械臂；然而能定义字段，并不证明十四关节足球策略已学会。当前优先验证分层接口，再决定训练目标。
blocks.en: Learning joint actions is another route, with greater data and validation demands because balance and contact must also be learned. N1.7’s new-embodiment example supports non-end-effector actions. Definable fields, however, do not establish a learned fourteen-joint football policy. Validate the hierarchical interface before selecting the training target.

title.zh: 什么样的示范才有用

blocks.label: 示范质量、动作对齐和独立评测，比只有更多视频更关键。
nodes: 不同起点、指令、地面与恢复过程
当前图像/状态 → 随后的实际动作
按回合、房间与布局划分数据
先短距离，再扩展任务范围
blocks.zh: 示范质量、动作对齐和独立评测，比只有更多视频更关键。
blocks.en: Demonstration quality, action alignment and held-out evaluation matter beyond video quantity.

english_diagram.label: Demonstration quality, action alignment and held-out evaluation matter beyond video quantity.
nodes: Group by episode, room and layout
Start short, then expand task scope

blocks.zh: 现有日志可提供仿真中记录的图像、关节状态、惯性观测和实际执行动作，但单个成功回合远远不够。成功、失败和人工修正应保留明确标签；普通模仿学习不能把失败动作一概当作正确目标。必须区分策略原始输出、经过头部控制覆盖后的实际动作，以及电机真正执行的目标。
blocks.en: Existing logs contain images, joint state, inertial observations and executed actions, but one successful episode is far from sufficient. Keep success, failure and corrective demonstrations explicitly labeled; ordinary imitation learning must not treat every failed action as a correct target. Distinguish raw policy outputs, actions after gaze overrides and actual motor targets.

blocks.zh: 头部相机会随机器人运动，图像与动作有不同采样率。应按照时间对齐并记录观测年龄，避免拿未来画面解释过去动作。来自同一回合的相邻帧不能分别放入训练集与测试集；想验证陌生家庭场景，最好把整个房间或布局留作测试。
blocks.en: The head camera moves, and images/actions have different sampling rates. Align timestamps and observation ages without using future images for past actions. Do not split neighboring frames from one episode across train and test. Hold out complete rooms or layouts to assess unfamiliar homes.

title.zh: 接入可行性与下一次实验

blocks.zh: 官方新机器人配置、数据格式与策略接口已核查。已有轮滑记录中的 163 帧相机图像与关节状态能在同一时刻关联到 652 条动作中的对应条目；其中 97 条动作经过执行端修正，训练标签不能直接使用原始网络输出。本次检查的是 163 个单步对应关系；相机实际记录频率为 12.5 Hz，动作频率为 50 Hz。CPU 检查通过了官方输入形状检查及额外的时序、维度检查，尚未验证多步动作段，也没有加载 N1.7 权重、运行推理或微调。记录还需要补任务语言、动作转换配置与 LeRobot 数据导出，才能进入训练。
blocks.en: The official custom-embodiment configuration, data format and policy interface have been reviewed. Existing roller logs provide 163 image/state frames aligned with entries in 652 action records; 97 actions differ from the raw network output after executor corrections. This checks 163 one-step pairs at 12.5 Hz camera capture and 50 Hz action recording. Official shape validators and added timing/dimension checks pass; future multi-step action chunks remain unchecked. N1.7 weights were not loaded and no inference or fine-tuning ran. Task language, action-conversion configuration and LeRobot export are still needed for training.

blocks.zh: 这次检查采用 14 维低层动作记录来验证数据字段；前面建议的高层速度与技能接口仍需单独采集标签、实现执行桥。两条路线不能互相冒充。基础视觉骨干有模型访问要求，后续训练应使用与现有 Newton 仿真分开的环境。详见接口检查范围与尚缺条件。
blocks.en: This probe uses 14-dimensional low-level action records. The proposed high-level velocity/skill route still needs its own labels and executor; validating one does not validate the other. The visual backbone has model-access requirements. Keep future training dependencies separate from the existing Newton environment. See the readiness scope and remaining requirements.

blocks.zh: 下一次实验先固定一种运动方式和一个短距离任务，采集覆盖成功与恢复的示范，再按新起点和新房间评测。对照组使用同一机器人、道具、传感器与成功标准，分别记录进球、跌倒、停稳和观察次数。只有这样，才能判断学习策略是否真正减少反复调整。
blocks.en: For the next experiment, fix one locomotion mode and one short task, collect successful and corrective demonstrations, and evaluate unseen starts and rooms. Keep robot, props, sensors and success criteria identical across baselines; measure scoring, falls, stopping and observation cycles. This establishes whether learning actually reduces repeated corrections.

title.zh: 用 ASPIRE 组织任务并积累技能
title.en: Organize tasks and accumulate skills with ASPIRE

summary.zh: 让大模型提出方案、调用技能、检查反馈并修正程序；理解它与 GR00T、Agnes Harness 的关系。
summary.en: Let a model propose plans, call skills, inspect feedback and revise programs; distinguish ASPIRE, GR00T and Agnes Harness.

meta.zh: 第 8 章 · 预计学习时长 25 分钟

title.zh: 聪明的大脑需要可执行的身体接口
title.en: A reasoning model needs executable robot interfaces

blocks.zh: “先绕过椅子，再把球送进球门”同时包含目标理解、子任务安排和运动执行。大模型可以提出并调整任务计划；机器人控制器仍需要连续保持平衡和处理接触。这里的“完整路径”包括高层行动顺序，也可能需要几何避障路线，二者不能只用一段自然语言代替。
blocks.en: “Go around the chair and send the ball into the goal” combines goal interpretation, subtask organization and motion. A model can propose and revise a plan, while controllers maintain balance and handle contact. A complete plan may require both a high-level sequence and a geometric route; prose alone does not supply either validated execution or collision avoidance.

blocks.label: 把推理、技能执行和反馈连接起来，而不是让语言模型逐周期控制电机。
nodes: 图像、进度、失败与实际完成判据
blocks.zh: 把推理、技能执行和反馈连接起来，而不是让语言模型逐周期控制电机。
blocks.en: Connect reasoning, skill execution and feedback while retaining continuous motor control.

english_diagram.label: Connect reasoning, skill execution and feedback while retaining continuous motor control.
nodes: Interpret the goal; choose the next step
Images, progress, failures and outcome predicates

title.zh: ASPIRE：把尝试变成可复用经验
title.en: ASPIRE: turn attempts into reusable experience

blocks.zh: ASPIRE 的核心是代码形式的策略：智能体生成控制程序，执行后读取多模态记录，定位失败、修改程序，再把验证过的经验整理进技能库。这里的学习主要是程序与技能知识的迭代，不必每次都更新神经网络权重。当前官方公开的是 2026 年 10 月的 v1.0 工作流，包含迭代调试与演化搜索。
blocks.en: ASPIRE uses code-as-policy: an agent generates control programs, inspects multimodal execution traces, diagnoses failures, revises code and retains validated experience in a skill library. This learning primarily updates programs and skill knowledge, rather than necessarily updating neural weights. The public October 2026 v1.0 workflow includes iterative debugging and evolutionary search.

blocks.label: 通过真实执行反馈修正方案，验证后才复用。
nodes: 检索已有技能，生成程序

blocks.zh: 官方示例主要面向 LIBERO-Pro、Robosuite、BEHAVIOR-1K 与所列真实机械臂系统；当前没有本课程可直接使用的 Microduck 适配器。不能将机械臂末端位置控制替换成小鸭子的关节名字就宣布接通。我们可以复用 ASPIRE 的探索和技能库方法，同时为 Newton 环境实现机身运动与足球任务接口。
blocks.en: Official examples target LIBERO-Pro, Robosuite, BEHAVIOR-1K and documented real-arm systems. There is no ready Microduck adapter for this course. Renaming arm joints does not turn end-effector control into biped control. Reuse ASPIRE’s exploration and skill-library approach while implementing body-motion and football interfaces for Newton.

title.zh: ASPIRE 与 GR00T 可以怎样协作
title.en: How ASPIRE and GR00T can cooperate

blocks.zh: 可以先让 ASPIRE 调用已有运动策略，研究“如何组织任务”；等 Microduck 的 GR00T 适配经过验证，再把部分动作技能换成学习策略。GR00T 负责从当前观察生成动作，ASPIRE 负责目标分解、调用、检查与修正。这是一种分层接入方案，不是官方已经交付的 Microduck 组合。
blocks.en: Start by letting ASPIRE call existing motor skills to study task organization. Once a Microduck GR00T adaptation is validated, learned skills can replace selected action components. GR00T maps current observations to actions; ASPIRE organizes goals, calls, checks and revisions. This is a proposed integration, not an officially delivered Microduck stack.

blocks.zh: 对“不同任务都重写一遍”的改善，来自稳定的技能接口和经验复用。机器人仍需拥有完成任务所需的身体能力；例如没有抓取机构，单靠换提示词就不能保证完成捡拾。新任务也可能需要新的示范、技能或工具。
blocks.en: Stable skill interfaces and retained experience reduce repeated task programming. The robot still needs the physical capability for a task: a new prompt alone cannot guarantee pickup without suitable grasping hardware. New demonstrations, skills or tools may still be necessary.

blocks.zh: 两者存在共同概念，但并非同一个产品的替代名字。Agnes 的 MHS 设备接入与插件机制值得研究；当前公开主分支没有找到可直接复用的 Microduck 适配器。本课程暂不为它单独增加完整章节，避免重复讲智能体循环。
blocks.en: They share concepts but are not equivalent products. Agnes’s MHS device integration and plugins merit study, but the inspected public main branch contains no ready Microduck adapter. We keep it as an extension rather than repeat the agent loop in another full chapter.

blocks.zh: 可以参考这段 Microduck 社区演示，并关注它开放了哪些动作工具、如何判断完成、失败时如何恢复。该视频页面目前无法在资料核查环境读取，未独立核实其实现和自主程度，也未把它计作本课程实验结果。
blocks.en: The linked Microduck community demo is a useful reference for questions about action tools, completion checks and recovery. Its page was unavailable in this review environment; its implementation and autonomy level have not been independently verified or counted as course results.

title.zh: 可行，但需要桥接与独立验证

blocks.zh: 接入评估的结论是：ASPIRE 的方法和开放接口有接入价值；Microduck 执行桥、任务技能库与自动探索回合尚未完成。下一次先实现最小的“观察—有界移动—停止—检查”闭环，再接入射门。保留开发种子与独立测试种子，限制每轮尝试预算，记录成功率、恢复次数与模型调用开销。
blocks.en: The method and open interfaces are promising. A Microduck execution bridge, skill library and autonomous exploration trials remain to be implemented. Begin with observe, bounded movement, stop and check, then extend to football. Separate development and held-out seeds, bound trial budgets and record success, recovery and model-call costs.
