title.zh: 换一个家，机器人会遇到什么变化

blocks.zh: 这类变化值得训练时考虑。相同的球在暖光、逆光和阴影下可能很不一样；白墙、地砖纹理和桌椅会改变目标背景；狭窄通道改变接近路线，地毯或光滑地面则改变运动与制动。视觉泛化、空间规划和动力学适应需要分别处理，不能只给球场换一张贴图。
blocks.en: These variations matter. Warm light, backlighting and shadows change the ball’s appearance; walls, tiles and furniture change its background. Narrow passages change routes, while carpet and smooth floors change motion and braking. Visual generalization, spatial planning and dynamics adaptation need separate treatment.

zh: 图像识别与视觉动作策略
保持几何与动作一致，测试新外观
新布局中的闭环任务与碰撞检查
物理参数范围与实机测量
多种表达和独立任务组合
en: Test new appearance with consistent geometry/actions
Closed-loop tasks and collisions in new layouts
Language variation and held-out task combinations

title.zh: Cosmos 3 能提供什么

blocks.zh: Cosmos 3 是当前公开的多模态世界模型家族，统一处理语言、图像、视频、音频与动作。官方提供 Reasoner、Generator 以及专门的策略与仿真变体，可以用于理解场景、生成候选情境或研究动作与未来状态的关系。它不只是“给视频换背景”的工具。
blocks.en: Cosmos 3 is a public omnimodal world-model family covering language, images, video, audio and actions. Reasoner, Generator and specialized policy/simulation variants support scene understanding, candidate scenario generation and action/future-state modeling. Its scope extends beyond background replacement.

blocks.zh: 对 Microduck，最直接的切入点是扩充视觉训练数据与分析失败场景。例如保留机器人、球门和球的位置，用更丰富的房间外观生成候选数据，再筛查目标形状、遮挡和时间连续性。对需要深度、分割等空间控制的生成流程，也应按实际接口比较 Cosmos-Transfer2.5 等专用模型，而不只看版本编号。
blocks.en: For Microduck, initial uses include visual-data expansion and failure analysis. Preserve robot, goal and ball geometry while generating candidate room appearances, then inspect shape, occlusion and temporal consistency. Where depth or segmentation conditioning is required, compare the actual interfaces of specialized models such as Cosmos-Transfer2.5 as well.

blocks.zh: 生成了一段看似进球的视频，不等于得到真实可执行的机器人动作。只有在动作标签与图像、状态和时间仍一致时，数据才适合模仿学习；球变大、门柱移动或接触时刻改变，都可能让原动作标签失效。Cosmos 的策略与动作建模能力也需要对应机器人数据适配，不能直接把 DROID 等具身变体称为 Microduck 策略。
blocks.en: A plausible scoring video is not an executable action trajectory. Imitation data require action labels consistent with images, states and timing. A changed ball size, post position or contact time can invalidate the original actions. Cosmos policy/action variants likewise need embodiment adaptation; a DROID specialization is not a Microduck policy.

blocks.zh: Cosmos 也有世界仿真与策略变体，但本课程仍用 Newton 记录触球、进球与停车的物理证据。OSMO 负责工作流编排；它不会自动把互不兼容的机器人动作空间变成一个通用训练目标。
blocks.en: Cosmos also has world-simulation and policy variants. This course retains Newton for physical evidence of contact, scoring and stopping. OSMO orchestrates workflows; it does not automatically reconcile incompatible action spaces into a common learning target.

title.zh: 机器人 × 场景 × 任务：Isaac Lab-Arena

blocks.zh: 多机器人、多场景、多任务的组合，更直接对应 Isaac Lab-Arena。它把环境拆成 Scene（场景）、Embodiment（机器人、传感器与动作）和 Task（任务与完成判据），再组装为 Isaac Lab 环境。可以组织多种布局、机器人和任务的评测，也可把环境注册到学习与数据生成流程。截至 2026 年 10 月 26 日核查的 main 对应 Isaac Lab 3.0 / Isaac Sim 6.2，属于仍在演进的早期版本；不能与 release/0.3.1 分支的依赖混用。
blocks.en: Isaac Lab-Arena directly addresses composition. It separates Scene, Embodiment (robot, sensors and actions), and Task (objective and predicates), then builds Isaac Lab environments. It organizes evaluation across layouts, robots and tasks and registers environments for learning/data workflows. The main branch inspected on October 26, 2026 targets Isaac Lab 3.0 / Isaac Sim 6.2 and remains early-stage software; its dependencies differ from release/0.3.1.

blocks.zh: Arena 已有 GR00T 等策略客户端，也有 Cosmos 相关适配；支持选择 Newton。Microduck 仍需补自己的具身、足球任务和动作契约。不同机器人的组合必须满足任务能力要求；多环境并行评测，也不自动等于训练了一个能控制所有机器人的统一模型。
blocks.en: Arena provides policy clients including GR00T and Cosmos-related adapters and supports Newton selection. Microduck still needs its own embodiment, football task and action contract. Combinations must satisfy task capabilities. Concurrent evaluation does not itself train a single policy for every robot.

blocks.zh:
试着规划一组评测

blocks.en:
Design an evaluation matrix

This only counts combinations; it launches no simulation or training. Unchecking a factor fixes it to one condition.

blocks.zh: 轮滑与步行是同一机器人上的两种模式，这里分别评测，不能把它们算成两种实体机器人。组合数只是实验设计规模，不代表这些实验已经运行，也不代表所有组合都合理。
blocks.en: Walking and skating are modes of one robot and are evaluated separately here; they are not two physical embodiments. The count describes an experiment design, not completed runs or universal compatibility.

title.zh: 怎样判断随机化真正有帮助
title.en: How to test whether randomization helps

blocks.zh: 先保留一个无新增随机化的对照，再分别加入外观变化、布局变化和有实测依据的动力学变化；控制示范数量、训练预算与评测标准。把陌生房间、布局或部分组合留到最终测试，避免模型只记住生成场景。不要在看到失败后重跑到成功再替换记录。
blocks.en: Keep a baseline with no added randomization, then separately add appearance, layout and measured dynamics variation while controlling demonstration count, training budget and evaluation criteria. Hold out rooms, layouts or combinations. Keep failed trials rather than replace them with successful retries.

blocks.zh: 指标不只看检测分数：还看完整进球与停稳、跌倒、路径碰撞、观察循环次数和完成时间。现有实验提示几何提取与制动也存在瓶颈；视觉随机化可能改善观察，却不会自动修复停车控制。先按失败类型补数据或改接口，再扩大训练。
blocks.en: Measure full scoring and settling, falls, route collisions, observation cycles and completion time, not just detection scores. Current failures also involve geometry extraction and braking. Visual randomization may improve observations without fixing stopping control. Target the observed failure before scaling training.

title.zh: 下一步：先做可比较的小实验

blocks.zh: 先选择一种运动方式，固定官方 10 cm 足球与球门；使用两种足球地面、大理石和木地板，增加可控光照，再加入少量室内布局。球门材质保持固定。完成仿真传感器与实际执行动作记录的对齐后，再选择 GR00T 微调、ASPIRE 技能探索或 Cosmos 数据扩展中的一条作为首个实验，避免同时改变所有因素。
blocks.en: Choose one locomotion mode, keep the official 10 cm ball and goal fixed, and use the two football floors, marble and wood with controlled lighting, then a small set of indoor layouts. Keep goal-frame material fixed. After aligning simulated sensor data with executed action records, select one initial experiment: GR00T adaptation, ASPIRE skill exploration or Cosmos data expansion, rather than change everything together.

blocks.zh: 课程已核查方法、接口与已有记录字段，并给出组合设计；尚未执行新的 GR00T、ASPIRE、Cosmos 或 Arena 训练/控制实验。下一阶段以独立闭环结果决定是否扩大数据和算力投入。
blocks.en: The course reviews methods, interfaces and existing record fields, and illustrates combination design. No new GR00T, ASPIRE, Cosmos or Arena training/control experiment has run. Independent closed-loop results should guide subsequent data and compute investment.

blocks.zh: 建议先从任务配置入手，理解观测、动作和奖励，再进一步研究物理引擎与传感器接口。这里使用的是固定版本，而官方文档可能已经介绍更新版本，因此比较参数前必须先核对版本。
blocks.en: Begin with task observations, actions, and rewards, then explore physics and sensors. Course commands target fixed versions; current documentation may describe newer versions. Check the version before applying changes.

title.zh: 建议的延伸练习

zh: 调整第三章的训练预算，并在相同的独立测试种子上比较表现。
比较第六章的两种射门方式：哪些失败来自观察，哪些来自动作与衔接？
根据第七章的示范数据流程，列出 Microduck 与 SO-101 的共同步骤和不同动作接口。
用第九章的组合计数器规划陌生房间评测，说明哪些条件用于训练、哪些留作测试。
en: Vary the Chapter 3 training budget and compare on the same held-out seeds.
Compare the two Chapter 6 modes: which failures concern observation, action or handoff?
Use Chapter 7 to identify shared data-workflow steps and different action interfaces for Microduck and SO-101.
Use the Chapter 9 counter to plan held-out room evaluation and separate training from test conditions.
